title: Brand Manager - International Markets
description:
**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** 
 is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait.**




 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  





 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  





 "
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Job Description
   

  





 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Business Manager to ensure successfully driving marketing initiatives, developing, and executing new product launch plans, conducting effective sales force training, and implementing market research strategies for brand performance enhancement. Collaborating with the CFT team across BUs i.e., Portfolio, RA, SCM, CoE, Legal \& compliance team for supporting smooth business operation. Ready to travel to different countries and work in dynamic international business environment.
   

  





 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  





 Brand management:
   

  




1. Driving marketing activities in assigned markets (countries) in co\-ordination with local teams and business partners.


1. Marketing planning for key brands, preparing scientific marketing materials and communication with medical affairs team.


1. Product performance review by gathering market insights, identifying key issues, and implementing action plans to maintain optimal brand performance, including conducting market research for brand positioning correction.


1. Interacting with Key Opinion Leader (KOLs), conducting fieldwork to gather insights, updating KOLs on product value, and collating product evidence and clinical reports to build strong relationships and drive growth.


1. New product launch planning and execution, by preparing product launch materials, coordinating launch meetings, organising launch events (CMEs/Pharmacist meeting), training the sales force, and tracking product performance.


1. Implementation of new initiative in sales and marketing etc. (DRL best practices)


1. Travelling to countries for new launches, Field work and Products training.


1. Co\-ordination with sales teams and review of field activities tracking of implementation of agreed plans.



 New product evaluation:
   

  




1. Analysis of available data set of the countries for new product evaluation, Filing and introduction


1. Market assessment of TAs, Molecules, and analysis of competitive landscape for new launches


1. Driving new products evaluation with CFT team i. e. Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Project managers, Medical Affairs.


1. Conducting market research (primary \& secondary), meeting various stakeholders (Partners, Doctors, Retailers etc.) in country for new product introduction



 Strategy:
   

  




1. Regular market data analysis for business performance, competition tracking


1. Develop and update 5 years rolling start plan for assigned geography.


1. Preparing management presentation – Budget PPT, MRMs, QRMs


1. Primary and secondary sales analysis, Tracking inventory \& DOH.


1. MIS \& tracking promo expenses



 Operation support:
   

  




1. Co\-ordination with internal functions i.e., CoE, Finance, Compliance, Legal, Pharmacovigilance, logistics, procurement teams for day\-to\-day functioning and decision making.


**Qualifications**

 Qualifications:
   

  





 Educational qualification\- Science/Pharma graduate with MBA in Marketing/International Business
   

  





 Minimum work experience\- 5\-7 years of experience in marketing/Brand/Product management. Relevant international business experience /Sales experience will be an added advantage however, not limitation.
   

  





 Skills \& attributes
   

  

 Technical Skills:
   

  




1. Understanding of Pharmaceutical industry; ability to interpret market data; gain marketing insights from various resources.


1. Ability to analyse market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs within the generics market.


1. Strong problem\-solving skills to address regulatory challenges, market access issues, and product\-related issues.


1. Basic understanding of anatomy and physiology.



 Behavioural Skills:
   

  




1. Strong interpersonal skills, facilitating positive relationships with cross cultural teams and effective communication.


1. Demonstrates proficiency in presenting information, ideas, or data effectively to others.


1. Good analytical skills, enabling interpretation and analysis of information for decision\-making.


1. Result oriented and with a work ethic of delivering on\-time and in scope.


**Additional Information**

 Benefits Offered
   

  





 At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
   

  





 The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
   

  





 " Our Work Culture
   

  





 Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
   

  





 For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/\#!/"

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Vision \& Delivery
+ Partner with Product Leadership to define and execute the roadmap for the Payer Agentic Platform (PAP) and its portfolio of AI\-powered payer solutions
+ Translate strategic objectives into actionable product requirements, technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans
+ Drive execution across platform capabilities, reusable services, and agent\-specific initiatives including Benefit Inquiry, Pricing Inquiry, Policy Inquiry, Prior Authorization, and future agent use cases
+ Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable platform capabilities that accelerate time\-to\-market and maximize reuse
+ Ensure all product investments align to measurable business outcomes, operational efficiencies, and customer value

* Platform \& Technical Product Management
+ Own the technical product lifecycle from ideation through deployment and operational readiness
+ Partner closely with engineering teams to define functional and non\-functional requirements, APIs, integration patterns, platform services, and system dependencies
+ Drive backlog refinement, prioritization, sprint planning, and release orchestration across multiple development teams
+ Collaborate with architects to define scalable platform patterns supporting agent orchestration, grounding, retrieval, workflow automation, and interoperability across enterprise systems
+ Ensure platform capabilities support configurability, extensibility, governance, security, and future expansion of the PAP ecosystem

* Agentic AI Product Delivery
+ Support delivery of AI\-powered experiences leveraging LLMs, agent orchestration frameworks, knowledge grounding, workflow automation, and decision support capabilities
+ Partner with Product Managers and Data teams to define evaluation criteria, quality measures, performance benchmarks, and monitoring strategies for AI\-driven solutions
+ Help establish repeatable delivery processes that accelerate development and scaling of new payer agents
+ Drive implementation of responsible AI practices, transparency requirements, and governance controls throughout the product lifecycle

* Cross\-Functional Leadership
+ Lead cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Business stakeholders
+ Coordinate execution with internal Optum teams and strategic external partners
+ Manage inter\-team dependencies, identify risks, remove blockers, and ensure alignment across multiple workstreams
+ Represent technical product priorities and delivery progress in leadership reviews, steering committees, and operational governance forums

* Program Execution \& Delivery Management
+ Develop integrated release plans, dependency maps, and milestone tracking across PAP initiatives
+ Ensure product increments are delivered on time, meet acceptance criteria, and align with business commitments
+ Drive issue resolution and escalation management across engineering and business teams
+ Support Alpha, Beta, Production, and commercialization readiness activities

* Performance Measurement \& Reporting
+ Define and monitor KPIs tied to:
- Product adoption
- Agent accuracy and performance
- Delivery predictability
- Platform scalability
- Feature utilization
- Operational efficiency
- Business impact

+ Provide executive\-ready updates on roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, and milestone achievement

* AI Tool Utilization
+ Utilize Microsoft M365 Copilot to accelerate backlog creation, user story development, acceptance criteria generation, documentation, and test planning
+ Leverage Teams Copilot to streamline stakeholder communications, meeting follow\-ups, action item management, and dependency tracking

* Utilize AI\-enabled product management tools such as Aha!, Rally, and other platform capabilities to improve
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field
* 11\+ years in healthcare services, healthcare technology, or software development , Product Management, or a related field
* 5\+ years of Technical Product Management, Product Management, or equivalent technology delivery experience
* 5\+ years of experience working directly with software engineering teams in Agile environments
* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Experience managing product backlogs, roadmaps, releases, and cross\-functional delivery efforts
* Experience working with cloud\-based platforms, APIs, system integrations, and enterprise applications
* Proven solid communication and stakeholder management skills with both technical and business audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Healthcare payer experience including benefits, eligibility, claims, policy, utilization management, or prior authorization domains
* Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, or conversational AI solutions
* Experience delivering platform\-based products that support multiple downstream applications and use cases
* Experience working with AI product evaluation, governance, and responsible AI practices
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple product and engineering teams
* Familiarity with Google Cloud, Azure AI, API\-driven architectures, and integration frameworks
* Proficiency using Microsoft M365 Copilot and AI\-enabled product management tools to accelerate product delivery
* Proven solid analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive decisions


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Technical, Data Platform Team, Hyderabad
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 









**Senior Staff Product Manager – Technical (Data \& Audience Platform Team), Hyderabad** 








 About Warner Bros. Discovery:
 
 Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.
 



 For more information, please visit
 **www.wbd.com** 
 .
 



  


**Meet our team** 




 The Data and Audience Platform team sits within the Data \& Analytics organization in WBD's Global Tech division. We build the data platform behind our streaming services and content businesses \- the pipelines, data lakes, and serving infrastructure that turn billions of events into audience insights, personalization, and intelligent products.
   

  
   


**About the Role**




 The Senior Staff Product Manager\-Tech, AI/ML Roadmap and Platform Strategy, will define and drive the Data \& Audience Platform (DAP) AI roadmap across predictive ML, GenAI, agentic workflows, AI\-enabled analytics, data activation, and AI\-native platform capabilities. This role is intentionally AI\-centric: it exists to elevate DAP from a data and analytics platform organization into a product\-led AI enablement function that identifies the highest\-value AI opportunities, chooses the right technologies, and converts experimentation into durable business outcomes.
 







 This role will be accountable for disciplined AI product strategy: selecting the right problems, validating that the newest technology is actually the best fit, defining measurable business value up front, and ensuring platform investments are reusable, governed, cost\-aware, and scalable. The role will work across DAP, engineering, analytics, data science, architecture, product, operations, privacy/legal, AI governance, and senior leadership to make AI investments actionable, safe, and outcome driven.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* Shape AI product strategy and roadmap priorities across DAP platform areas.
* Evaluate AI/ML opportunities through value, feasibility, cost, data readiness, governance, and reuse lenses.
* Write AI\-focused PRDs, product briefs, model/agent behavior requirements, evaluation criteria, and launch readiness requirements.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and architecture to compare model, platform, vendor, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Define KPIs and decision frameworks that connect AI outputs to business outcomes.
* Run AI roadmap, prioritization, value review, and post\-launch measurement forums.
* Translate complex AI/ML concepts into clear executive narratives and actionable decisions.
* Identify when AI work should be standardized as a shared platform capability versus delivered as a bespoke solution.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to intake, define, identify risks, and schedule work to develop key features.
* Formulate a point of view on how proposed features align with business goals and our tech strategy.



  


**What to Bring:** 



* 12\+ years of product management, technical product management, AI/ML product strategy, data platform, analytics, or related experience.
* Deep experience defining and delivering AI/ML, GenAI, data platform, customer intelligence, analytics, activation, or enterprise platform products at scale.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts including model lifecycle, experimentation, model evaluation, MLOps, data quality, governance, semantic layers, feature/data products, and post\-launch performance measurement.
* Practical fluency in modern AI patterns such as LLMs, RAG, agentic systems, AI orchestration, prompt and agent lifecycle management, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and AI observability.
* Demonstrated ability to set product vision and direction across multiple teams and highly ambiguous technical domains.
* Strong ability to evaluate technology tradeoffs across capability, quality, scalability, privacy, security, cost, maintainability, and business value.
* Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into clear decisions, narratives, and value cases.
* Proven ability to influence without authority across engineering, architecture, data science, TPM, analytics, operations, business, governance, and senior leadership teams.
* Track record of delivering measurable customer, business, operational, or platform impact from technical product investments.



  


**The Nice to Haves** 



* Experience with streaming media, digital video, Customer 360, personalization, recommendations, content intelligence, advertising analytics, audience activation, commerce analytics, marketing analytics, or global platform products.
* Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, model risk review, privacy/security requirements, or compliance needs for AI\-powered products.
* Experience creating scalable intake, prioritization, value management, and post\-launch measurement mechanisms for AI portfolios.
* Experience with AI cost management, cloud/data platform FinOps, model inference cost tradeoffs, vendor evaluation, or build/buy/reuse decisioning.
* Experience mentoring senior PMs / PM\-Ts and raising product craft across a matrixed organization.



  


**What We Offer:** 



* A Great Place to work.
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

title: Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Applied AI Senior Product Specialist
   

  

 An Applied AI Senior Product Specialist is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-function al product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cas h learning loop—automatin g analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—am plified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy\-align ed solutions to achieve product value objectives.
* Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Vision and Strategy
* Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
* Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
* Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.
* Market and User Engagement
* Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelera ting the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
* Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Work side\-by\-side with cross\-function al (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
* Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
* Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.
* Continuous Improvement
* Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
* Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
* Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force\-multipli er to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
* Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.
* Applied AI Ways of Working
* Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—char ting new pathways for the business rather than only collecting requirements.
* Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compre ssing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chie f—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
* Amplify experimentatio n: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.


 The successful candidate will possess:
   

  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


 The team
   

  

 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI\-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this t ransformation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of proven experience in product management or related roles.
* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 0\-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sec tors you serve
* Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week
* Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select location available for this role


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience being accountable for value and viability results for an empowered product team.
* Experience in modern product craft of delivering the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Experience in modern product management craft and domain (tools, methods, and practices).
* Experience with lean solutions and rapid, inexpensive experimentatio n to emerge the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Accountability for value, viability and P\&L objectives for a product.
* Quick to reach expert\-level knowledge within the product domain being served.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and derive actionable insights.
* Problem\-Solvin g: Innovative and experimental approach to solving complex problems.
* Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire cross\-function al teams, fostering collaboration and collective movement toward product goals.
* Customer\-Centr icity: Deep understanding of customer needs and engagement patterns, driving teams to deliver solutions that customers love and that work for the business.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for the product, aligning it with broader business objectives.
* AI Agentic Fluency: Comfortable orchestrating multiple AI agents across the concept\-to\-cas h flow (research, insight, prototyping, specification, coding, and compliance), with guardrails at each hand\-off—assum ptions, confidence levels, and links to sources of truth.
* AI Realism and Eval Fluency: Understands the difference between deterministic logic and probabilistic generation; designs guardrails for hallucination, bias, and drift; uses evaluation harnesses before launch and monitors drift after, with a kill\-switch mentality—and knows when not to use AI.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Zenopsys** 


 Zenopsys is building a world where life\-saving medicines are never delayed by paperwork and operational bottlenecks. 
 





 Zenopsys is an AI\-native documentation workspace built for the Life Sciences industry. Our platform uses Agentic AI to automate and streamline documentation across the product lifecycle—from
 
**R\&D and Clinical Development to Regulatory Submissions, Quality, and Post\-Market activities** 

 .
 




**We help medicines and therapies reach the market 6\-24 sooner!** 



**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for a highly curious, analytical and customer\-focused Associate Product Manager who can work closely with product, engineering, sales and customers to build and improve Zenopsys products.
 





 You will understand customer workflows and problems, translate them into product requirements, support feature development, conduct product demos, gather customer feedback and help drive product adoption and satisfaction.
 





 The ideal candidate should be a strong problem solver,an excellent communicator, and passionate about building AI\-powered products.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**Product Management** 
* Work with senior product leaders to define, prioritize and build product features.
* Understand customer workflows and convert business problems into clear product requirements.
* Create user stories, feature requirements, acceptance criteria and product documentation.
* Track features from ideation through development, testing, release and adoption.
* Act as the Product Owner for assigned features/modules.


**Customer \& Product Solutions** 
* Understand how customers use Zenopsys for their internal operations and identify opportunities to improve their workflows.
* Conduct customer discussions, capture feedback and translate insights into actionable product improvements.
* Support customer onboarding and product adoption.
* Help resolve product\-related queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Track customer satisfaction, usage and recurring product issues.


**Product Demonstrations \& Sales Support** 
* Become a Zenopsys product expert and develop a deep understanding of the platform and its use cases.
* Conduct product demonstrations for prospects and existing customers.
* Support the Sales/Business Development team during pre\-sales discussions, discovery calls and solution presentations.
* Understand customer requirements and demonstrate how Zenopsys can address their specific business problems.
* Support post\-sales teams with product knowledge, customer training and adoption initiatives.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 
* Work closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Regulatory, Sales, Customer Success and Leadership teams.

title: Product Lead Data Management Services
description:
**Job Title: Product Lead Data Management Services**
 HSBC Data \& Analytics Office (DAO) promotes a data\-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:
   

  

* Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.
* Connect: Move to a data\-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.
* Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well\-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercialising our data, optimising capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.


 We are hiring a Product Lead \- DMS within Data Management Services (part of Data \& Analytics Office)
   

  

 The Data function owns the bank’s data controls and the ecosystem of tools that allows every business and function to implement and evidence those controls. That ecosystem is being rebuilt: legacy tools are being redesigned, new platforms are being brought in, and the target state is a fully automated, control\-by\-design data estate, where data quality, lineage, metadata, classification, retention, access and issue management are largely machine\-executed rather than manually attested.
   

  

 We are hiring a Product Lead to own that estate end to end. This is a build\-and\-scale mandate on a compressed timeline, not a steady\-state product management role. The successful candidate will set the product strategy, consolidate a fragmented tooling landscape into a coherent platform, lead the product community, and be personally accountable for landing the target state within an aggressive delivery window.
   

  

**Governance and Committee Memberships**
* The jobholder will continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.
* The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.
* The jobholder will implement the Group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply


**In This Role, You Will**
* Own the DMS product vision and multi\-year roadmap to deliver the bank\-wide automated data control journey (control\-by\-design, scalable and measurable). Convert control outcomes into deliverable increments (epics/features) with clear acceptance criteria and benefits tracking (e.g., automation rate, evidence quality, adoption, cycle\-time reduction).
* Partner with Data Technology and Architecture to define the target state and make explicit buy / build / configure / retire decisions, including legacy rationalisation and decommissioning. Create platform consistency by setting common product standards/patterns across DMS (e.g., workflow, APIs, integration patterns, MI/metrics, auditability) so tools operate as one coherent estate.
* Lead and develop the Product Owner community across the DMS portfolio, setting direction, ways of working and a consistent bar for discovery, prioritisation and outcome delivery. Orchestrate delivery through matrix technology teams (without direct line management), aligning priorities, managing dependencies, removing blockers and ensuring shared accountability for outcomes.
* Run portfolio\-level prioritisation and capacity allocation to ensure engineering effort is focused on the highest\-risk/highest\-value control outcomes, with realistic sequencing and transparent trade\-offs. Establish and operate strong delivery governance to maintain delivery momentum and quality.
* Drive adoption and change at scale (training, communications, migrations) ensuring DMS tooling becomes the “path of least resistance” for Data Owners, Data Stewards and control teams. Ensure risk, regulatory and control\-by\-design compliance: DMS products must meet HSBC standards for security, resilience, data privacy/records management and third\-party risk, and provide defensible evidence/MI for Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.
* Lead a team of Product Owners and create a high\-performing product community with consistent standards, shared patterns, and a bias to shipping incremental value. Build strong partnerships across Data Technology, Data Operations, Architecture, Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance, CCO and Internal Audit. Drive collaboration across geographies and functions; manage competing priorities through transparency, evidence\-based trade\-offs and clear decisions


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Strong knowledge of data management capabilities and controls: metadata management, data governance, data quality, lineage, classification, privacy and retention, and how they enable evidence\-based control execution. Strong product leadership experience across enterprise platforms and tooling, ideally within a large regulated organisation.
* Proven ability to lead delivery through matrix technology teams and multiple Product Owners, shaping work without relying on formal reporting lines. Understanding of regulatory drivers and control frameworks relevant to data management
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain trade\-offs and prioritisation decisions to senior audiences. 15\+ years’ experience in product management, data, technology or control\-related roles; experience leading a portfolio/team of Product Owners is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech) or Computer Applications (BCA) or Science (BSc – Computer Science/Statistics/Mathematics) from a recognised university.
* Track record of delivering complex tooling/platform change with measurable outcomes (automation, adoption, risk reduction, cost/efficiency).
* Desirable: experience modernising or rationalising legacy tooling; experience with cloud and modern data platforms; experience implementing data governance/quality/lineage tooling at scale.


**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. title: Data Management Lead - Agentic AI for Data
description:
**Job Description**
 Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. You will also support executive communications by synthesizing progress into concise narratives, metrics, and roadmap updates.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Define end\-to\-end requirements for the build of an agentic solution for the data persona that enables end\-to\-end data product development, in alignment with firmwide data guidelines and standards.
* Lead discovery with business teams to document current workflows, identify friction points, and translate needs into a prioritized intake backlog. Also demonstrate how the agent addresses these pain points.
* Design and run structured user\-feedback loops (interviews, shadowing sessions, usability tests, telemetry review) to continuously refine tool capabilities against real DPM workflows.
* Partner with engineering leads to convert business needs into well\-scoped technical requirements and discrete, assignable tasks for data engineers and AI engineers.
* Validate delivered capabilities by reviewing agent behaviors, generated outputs, and integrated workflows to ensure they match intent and agreed standards.
* Define and track acceptance criteria, success metrics, and evaluation frameworks (e.g., agent task\-completion rate, output quality, human\-in\-the\-loop intervention rate) for each capability release.Coordinate delivery execution through backlog refinement, sprint planning support, release readiness checks, and dependency management across teams.
* Contribute to the multi\-year roadmap for scaling the agentic tool from PoC to a firmwide platform – including capability expansion, LOB onboarding sequencing, and platform hardening.
* Develop a working point of view on the target agentic architecture: orchestration patterns, scheduling, agent\-to\-agent communication, memory/state management, tool registries, and evaluation infrastructure.
* Identify reusable components, shared services, and integration points with existing firmwide data platforms and skills repositories.
* Partner with governance, risk, controls, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure responsible use and appropriate controls are embedded into the solution. Collaborate and align with data engineers, data scientists, product managers, architects, and technology partners to achieve business outcomes.
* Drive coordination and communication with senior stakeholders to advance the DDLC strategy and secure ongoing sponsorship. Produce executive\-ready materials: roadmap updates, PoC readouts, adoption metrics, and business\-value narratives.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Demonstrated understanding of agentic artificial intelligence patterns, including single\-agent, multi\-agent, and orchestrated approaches.
* Working knowledge of generative artificial intelligence building blocks, including large language models, prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, context design, evaluation methods, and safety controls.
* Hands\-on experience using modern generative artificial intelligence development tools (for example, enterprise\-approved coding assistants or agent\-enabled integrated development environments).
* Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including deployment pipelines, continuous integration and continuous delivery, environment promotion, testing strategies, and observability.
* Working knowledge of the data development lifecycle, including data modeling, schema and contract design, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and publishing standards.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical work items, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience running pilots in a large, regulated enterprise environment, including stakeholder alignment and release discipline.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect senior stakeholder priorities to engineering execution.
* Track record of end\-to\-end delivery in data, data science, or data product work in consulting or internal consulting contexts.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.
* Familiarity with evaluation operations for generative artificial intelligence (for example, test harnesses, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices).
* Advanced degree in a quantitative, computer science, or data\-related discipline.
* Familiarity with financial services environments, including operating in control\-conscious delivery models.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

title: City Head - Medtech Company, Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
 The City Head — Hyderabad is a business\-founder role. You will own the full P\&L for Hyderabad, architect the go\-to\-market strategy, build and lead a high\-performance team, and be the face of the organisation's category\-building mission in the city. This is not a sales management role — it is a general management role with the remit to shape how cardiac rhythm intelligence gets adopted across hospitals, cardiologists, electrophysiologists, and diagnostic networks in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Revenue Growth \& Business Development


 ▸ Own revenue targets for Hyderabad across all product lines — ambulatory monitoring, CRI platform subscriptions, and clinical services.
   

  

 ▸ Drive new account acquisition across hospitals, cardiology departments, EP labs, and diagnostic chains; develop a pipeline management discipline with clear conversion metrics.
   

  

 ▸ Design and execute city\-level GTM playbooks — account mapping, HCP engagement, institutional tie\-ups, and channel partnerships.
   

  

 ▸ Identify and unlock high\-value revenue levers: hospital protocols, corporate wellness, insurance partnerships, and tele\-cardiology integrations.
   

  

 ▸ Track, forecast, and report revenue performance weekly; model scenario\-based growth plans in alignment with national targets.
   

  

* P\&L Ownership \& Financial Management


 ▸ Own the Hyderabad P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, cost of delivery, operational expenses, and contribution margin.
   

  

 ▸ Build annual operating plans and quarterly budgets; manage actuals vs. plan with rigour and transparency.
   

  

 ▸ Drive profitability through unit economics discipline: monitor cost per case, revenue per account, and payback periods on acquisition spend.
   

  

 ▸ Identify and eliminate cost inefficiencies without compromising clinical quality or service experience.
   

  

 ▸ Report financial performance to CBO/leadership with insight\-driven commentary, not just numbers.
   

  

* Category Building — Cardiac Rhythm Intelligence


 ▸ Serve as the primary category evangelist for cardiac rhythm intelligence (CRI) in Hyderabad — among cardiologists, hospital administrations, and patient communities.
   

  

 ▸ Drive physician education and awareness programs around arrhythmia under\-diagnosis, the role of AI\-assisted monitoring, and clinical outcomes enabled by CRI.
   

  

 ▸ Build the organisation's brand equity in Hyderabad through CMEs, EP meets, clinical roundtables, and key opinion leader (KOL) engagement.
   

  

 ▸ Establish Hyderabad as a reference city for CRI adoption — creating case studies, clinical outcomes data, and institutional endorsements that support national and investor narratives.
   

  

 ▸ Work closely with the clinical and product teams to translate market feedback into platform evolution.
   

  

* Team Building \& People Leadership


 ▸ Recruit, develop, and retain a high\-performance Hyderabad team across sales, clinical coordination, operations, and customer success functions.
   

  

 ▸ Set clear KPIs and performance expectations; conduct regular reviews and coaching conversations.
   

  

 ▸ Create a culture of accountability, clinical empathy, and growth orientation — consistent with Organisation's mission\-driven DNA.
   

  

 ▸ Build bench strength: identify and develop successors and specialist leads within the city team.
   

  

 ▸ Act as the connective tissue between the city team and national functions (product, clinical, finance, marketing).
   

  

* Operations \& Service Excellence


 ▸ Ensure flawless service delivery across all active accounts — device logistics, turnaround times, report quality, and clinical support.
   

  

 ▸ Establish city\-level SOPs for onboarding, monitoring workflows, escalations, and renewals.
   

  

 ▸ Own NPS and retention metrics; build structured feedback loops with clinical partners to continuously improve service experience.
   

  

 ▸ Ensure regulatory and compliance adherence for all city operations.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like (Year 1\)
   

  

 Revenue \- Achieve or exceed Hyderabad annual revenue target; consistent MoM growth trajectory
   

  

 Accounts \- Establish active relationships with leading cardiac hospitals and EP labs in Hyderabad
   

  

 P\&L \- Deliver positive contribution margin by Q3; meet opex efficiency targets
   

  

 Category \- Conduct physician education events; establish 2–3 reference KOLs
   

  

 Team \- Full city team in place by Q2; attrition below benchmark
   

  

 NPS \- Net Promoter Score from clinical partners consistently above 60
   

  

 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

 ▸ 12–18 years of total experience; at least 5 years in a city/regional P\&L leadership role in healthcare, healthtech, medtech, diagnostics, or pharma.
   

  

 ▸ Proven track record of building revenue from early\-stage or expansion\-stage business units — not just managing mature accounts.
   

  

 ▸ Prior exposure to cardiac, rhythm management, diagnostics, or clinical SaaS strongly preferred.
   

  

 ▸ Experience hiring and leading cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.
   

  

 Leadership \& General Management
   

  

 ▸ Genuine owner mindset — treats the P\&L as their own business, not a cost centre.
   

  

 ▸ Comfortable with ambiguity; can build structure and process from scratch while executing simultaneously.
   

  

 ▸ Strong commercial instincts balanced with clinical sensitivity and respect for the healthcare context.
   

  

 ▸ Track record of coaching teams to performance, not just directing them.
   

  

 Category \& Market Building
   

  

 ▸ Experience or strong intuition for category creation — educating a market that may not yet know it has a problem is different from selling into an established need.
   

  

 ▸ Ability to engage credibly with cardiologists, electrophysiologists, hospital managements, and clinical decision\-makers.
   

  

 ▸ Comfortable being the face of the organisation externally — at conferences, CMEs, and institutional conversations.
   

  

 Analytical \& Operational
   

  

 ▸ Strong financial acumen — can read, build, and defend a P\&L; comfortable with unit economics modelling.
   

  

 ▸ Data\-driven decision\-maker; uses metrics to manage performance, not just report it.
   

  

 ▸ Operationally sharp — understands delivery logistics, turnaround time management, and service SLAs.

description:

This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Salesforce manager with people management and technical delivery
   

  

 Job Title: Salesforce Manager (10\+ Years Experience)
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
   

  

 Department: Enterprise Applications
   

  

 Reports To: Director \- Enterprise Applications
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Salesforce Manager will lead the strategy, architecture, delivery, and governance of the Salesforce ecosystem across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, and Health Cloud. This role requires deep technical expertise, healthcare domain awareness, and proven experience leading and managing high\-performing Salesforce teams.
   

  

 The individual will be accountable for platform delivery, team performance, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction while ensuring scalable, secure, and enterprise\-grade Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Leadership \& People Management
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Salesforce developers, administrators, and engineers.
* Drive performance management, career development, and succession planning within the team.
* Establish delivery standards, code quality benchmarks, and governance practices.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Manage capacity planning, sprint allocation, and resource forecasting.
* Partner with cross\-functional IT and business leaders to prioritize roadmap initiatives.


 Strategic Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Collaborate with functional stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements.
* Translate business needs into scalable Salesforce architecture and implementation plans.
* Provide executive\-level updates on platform health, roadmap progress, and risks.
* Champion business process optimization using Salesforce capabilities.


 Platform Configuration \& Custom Development
   

  

* Customize and configure Salesforce platform based on healthcare\-specific requirements.
* Design and implement:
* Custom objects and fields
* Validation rules
* Workflows and Process Builders
* Approval processes
* Lightning Flows
* Develop enterprise\-grade solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and NodeJS.
* Lead CPQ coding and implementation initiatives.
* Architect integrations using RESTful APIs and microservices.


 Data, Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Develop dashboards, reports, and advanced analytics solutions.
* Ensure data accuracy, normalization, and governance.
* Deliver insights to healthcare and sales leadership teams


 Security, Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Implement and enforce Salesforce security models including roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA and other healthcare regulations.
* Implement best practices aligned with GDPR and enterprise security frameworks.
* Protect patient data confidentiality and enterprise data integrity.


 Operational Excellence \& DevOps
   

  

* Monitor system performance and optimize platform stability.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production issues.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Salesforce CLI, and deployment automation tools.
* Drive Agile delivery practices and release governance.


 User Enablement \& Adoption
   

  

* Provide user training and ongoing support to healthcare and sales professionals.
* Drive adoption of Salesforce Sales and related applications.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 10\+ years of Salesforce development and enterprise implementation experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading and managing Salesforce teams.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in:
* Apex
* Visualforce
* Lightning Web Components
* NodeJS
* Strong experience in CPQ coding.
* Experience with Service Cloud and Health Cloud.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I \& II.
* Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data model architecture.
* Deep knowledge of Salesforce security and compliance frameworks.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Experience delivering enterprise implementations in global environments.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD tools.
* Strong business process mindset.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Healthcare industry experience.
* Experience working in regulated environments (HIPAA/GDPR).
* Experience leading distributed or global teams.
* Exposure to enterprise transformation programs.


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Act as platform owner and technical authority.
* Lead through influence, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Deliver secure, compliant, scalable Salesforce solutions.
* Build and retain high\-performing technical teams.

 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**The Job in short** 



* We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero\-to\-one product launch from concept to market.
* You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.
* This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi\-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.



  





**The Product Vision** 



* A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real\-time data integration into one coherent platform.
* Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code\-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.



  





**Our platform will:** 




 ● Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
 



 ● Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first\-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
 



 ● Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
 



 ● Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long\-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best\-in\-class products in the market.
 



 The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.
 



  





**Meet the job** 




**Strategic ownership** 




 ● Define the product roadmap for Workflows \& Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
 



 ● Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post\-launch, what never ships
 



 ● Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first\-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
 



 ● Shape both pro\-code and no\-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas
 



 Execution leadership
 



 ● Lead cross\-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
 



 ● Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
 



 ● Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
 



 ● Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively
 



 Partnership with peer PMs
 



 ● You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
 



 ● Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
 



 ● Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level
 



  





**How about you** 



* Experience shipping one or more of the following:
* Complex infrastructure or platform products · Enterprise workflow or automation systems · Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators) · Products that required deep technical integration · Zero\-to\-one launches where you shaped initial product\-market fit.



  





**Core capabilities** 




 ● Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
 



 ● Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature\-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
 



 ● Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
 



 ● Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
 



 ● Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
 



 ● AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● 5\+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
 



 ● Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
 



 ● Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
 



 ● Understanding of multi\-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
 



 ● Previous zero\-to\-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early\-stage product\-market fit.
 



 ● Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.
   

  

 As a Product Manager in Business Banking Lending, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Defines the product strategy and vision for Pricing and Risk Decision capabilities within Lending, translating business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap of features and enhancements.
* Owns the discovery process for pricing and risk decisioning needs, including stakeholder interviews and workflow analysis, and converts insights into well\-defined epics, user stories, and measurable outcomes.
* Establishes and governs the product backlog for pricing and risk decision work, balancing speed\-to\-value with operational readiness, risk posture, and long\-term platform health.
* Drives continuous improvement of the decisioning experience by identifying friction points, streamlining workflows, and enabling more automated, consistent, and transparent credit and pricing decisions.
* Ensures pricing and risk decision capabilities support regulatory, credit policy, and control requirements, and facilitates feedback loops that identify opportunities for ongoing product and process improvement.
* Builds features that strengthen decision quality and operational efficiency, including requirements for decision logic, approval workflows, exception handling, and audit trails, and partners with engineering to implement durable solutions.
* Defines and tracks success metrics for the roadmap, including decision turnaround time, approval rates, pricing accuracy, user adoption, and operational efficiency impacts.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 10\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a closely related domain.
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, including discovery, requirements definition, delivery planning, and value realization.
* Working knowledge of lending operations, credit risk assessment, and pricing methodologies sufficient to drive prioritization and informed trade\-offs with engineering, risk, and business partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams through ambiguity, align stakeholders on scope and sequencing, and deliver durable capabilities with clear adoption and outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.
* Experience building and scaling capabilities for regulated financial services domains, including lending, credit, or risk, with an understanding of the operational and control expectations for decisioning systems used in underwriting, pricing, and approval processes.
* Engineering background combined with an MBA or equivalent advanced business degree.
* Proven track record of working through ambiguous problems and driving product growth through innovative solutions and strategic feature development.on

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

 The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.

Visit us at www.zaggle.in to know more about us!
 



  





 We believe “Innovation is the Key” and Zaggle has been instrumental with launching multiple successful products in the last 3 years in the Business Spend Management space. Today we are a 300\+ member strong team spread across Technology, Product, Sales, Implementation Services, Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal and Support functions with 7 office locations in India.
 



  





**About the job** 




 Own the client\-driven P2P roadmap for requests that affect implementation, renewals and existing accounts. Prioritise client requirements, work with engineering to deliver them, and confirm that each release solves the issue raised.
 



 This hands\-on product role works closely with implementation, customer success, support and engineering on an enterprise SaaS platform with contractual timelines.
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




**Client requests and delivery** 



* Intake, triage and prioritisation of all requests from implementation, onboarding and existing clients.
* The backlog of existing\-client feature requests and enhancement asks — kept current, sized and defensible.
* A working partnership with customer success and support on the pain points blocking renewals or expansion.
* Acceptance criteria for client\-specific and client\-driven requirements, written so QA and engineering can act on them without a follow\-up meeting.
* Scoping and delivery timelines agreed with engineering, and the communication of those timelines to everyone waiting on them.
* SLA tracking for client and implementation commitments, including contract\-tied deadlines.
* Sprint delivery for client requests you own sprint completion rate and the scrum cadence for this track.
* Live issues, bug fixes and the technical debt that surfaces through client interactions.
* Status and timeline communication back to CS, implementation and support, without them having to chase you.
* Escalation of repeated requests upward as candidate roadmap items for the growth track.



**How success is measured** 



* Sprint completion rate on client requests; resolution time and SLA adherence
* Fewer implementation blockers; CSAT and NPS tied to responsiveness
* Churn risk mitigated through resolution of specific product gaps



**To succeed in the role** 




**Qualifications and experience** 



* This one is non\-negotiable: you must come from a P2P product background. The product you own today or owned most recently has to be a procure\-to\-pay product. We are not able to consider strong PMs from adjacent SaaS categories for this role.
* Minimum 3 years in product management, owning a product or module rather than only gathering requirements for one.
* Deep, current knowledge of the P2P industry: who the buyers are, how procurement and finance teams actually work, who you compete with and where each of you is weak.
* You can walk us through your product end to end the workflow, the edge cases, the trade\-offs you chose and why without a deck.
* Experience with enterprise clients, contractual SLAs and requirements that arrive mid\-implementation.
* Comfortable running a sprint with engineering: writing stories, defining acceptance criteria, sizing with the team, holding the cadence.
* Clear written communication. Most of this job is making a decision legible to people who were not in the room.



**P2P skills and know\-how** 



* Intake to procure: catalogue and non\-catalogue requisitions, approval matrices, budget checks, purchase requests, and the politics of an approval chain.
* PO lifecycle: PO creation and amendments, blanket and service POs, partial receipts, GRN, closures.
* Invoice to pay: invoice capture and OCR, two\-way and three\-way matching, exception and mismatch handling, credit and debit notes, payment runs.
* Vendor lifecycle: onboarding and KYC, bank account verification, vendor master data, vendor portals and self\-service.
* Compliance: GST and input credit, TDS, e\-invoicing and IRN, e\-way bill, audit trails and retention.
* Integrations: ERP and accounting sync SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Tally, Zoho through APIs or file\-based flows, and what breaks in the real world.
* Spend visibility: spend controls, budget consumption, and the reporting finance teams ask for after go\-live.



**Helpful experience** 



* Exposure to adjacent spend categories corporate cards, expense management, payables automation.
* Building configurable features on a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, where one client's request cannot become everyone's problem.
* Working fluency with Jira and SQL, enough to answer your own questions about usage and backlog health.
* Fintech or B2B payments experience in the Indian market.
