description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 LPL Financial is seeking a Consumption Data Product Owner to lead product ownership for consumption\-facing data capabilities. This role focuses on how enterprise data is discovered, understood, accessed, and used by downstream consumers across applications, analytics platforms, advisor experiences, operations, partners, and enterprise reporting.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, Consumer Enablement, and Data Analysis. The Consumption DPO is expected to operate as a true Product Manager, with the ability to look ahead, define a clear product strategy, build and maintain a roadmap, and align stakeholders around measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 The Consumption DPO helps translate consumer needs into data product capabilities by defining use cases, prioritizing demand, shaping data access patterns, and ensuring requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to enterprise data platform direction.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines product management discipline, strong analytical skills, data fluency, and stakeholder leadership. This person should be comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, data distribution capabilities, and downstream consumers to make data easier to consume, trust, and reuse.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership**
* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned consumption\-facing data capabilities.
* Translate business outcomes, consumer needs, and enterprise data strategy into clear roadmap priorities.
* Develop multi\-quarter roadmaps that balance strategic platform investments, consumer demand, risk reduction, operational needs, and delivery capacity.
* Use prioritization frameworks and evidence\-based tradeoff analysis to determine what should be delivered, sequenced, delayed, or deprioritized.
* Define success measures, KPIs, and OKRs that demonstrate product value, adoption, reliability, usability, and consumer impact.
* Communicate product direction, roadmap decisions, tradeoffs, and outcomes to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Consumer Discovery \& Product Definition**
* Engage downstream consumers to understand use cases, pain points, data needs, adoption barriers, and desired business outcomes.
* Translate consumer needs into clear data product problem statements, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release objectives.
* Define consumption patterns for data access through feeds, APIs, shared services, extracts, reporting platforms, and other approved channels.
* Represent the voice of the consumer in roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, sprint reviews, and platform design discussions.
* Help simplify the consumer experience by promoting reusable data products, standardized access patterns, and clear documentation.


**Data Product Ownership \& Consumption Enablement**
* Own or support assigned data products and consumption capabilities from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with data consumers, platform teams, engineering, architecture, and domain data owners to define scalable and reusable data consumption patterns.
* Maintain traceability between business intent, consumer requirements, data products, and technical implementation.
* Support definition and refinement of data contracts, schemas, interfaces, semantic definitions, usage expectations, and dependency documentation.
* Ensure consumption requirements are specific, testable, and aligned to the intended business outcome and consumer experience.


**Advanced Data Analysis \& Decision Support**
* Perform hands\-on data analysis to understand consumer usage, source\-to\-target relationships, dependencies, issues, and impacts.
* Analyze data quality, lineage, semantic consistency, data availability, and downstream impacts that affect consumer trust and usability.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, API changes, platform migrations, system decommissions, or changes to upstream sources.
* Use SQL, reporting, and analytical techniques to support product decisions, validate requirements, and identify durable solutions.
* Provide evidence\-based insights to inform prioritization, roadmap planning, consumer readiness, and delivery decisions.


**Agile Execution \& Delivery**
* Prioritize the product backlog for assigned consumption capabilities.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, UAT, release readiness, and retrospectives.
* Partner with engineering and QA teams to ensure delivered capabilities meet validated consumer needs and acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs across stakeholders, delivery teams, and platform partners.

title: Manager, Program Management, Brand Protection
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
   

  

 The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
   

  

 We are seeking a strategic, experienced Manager, Program Management to lead a team of program managers responsible for the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration of Brand Protection programs. This is a hybrid people\-leadership and program\-delivery role and you will own the performance, growth, and delivery output of your team while individually driving high\-impact programs that turn reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention, directly reducing brand abuse for rights owners globally.
   

  

 This role operates in ambiguous, cross\-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will shape the direction of your team's work, define what success looks like, and build the organizational capability to deliver with senior leadership visibility.
   

  

 This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, setting clear expectations, providing direct and constructive feedback, and coaching each team member to operate at the top of their level.
* Build a high\-performing team culture centered on ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession fostering an environment where PgMs can tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes problems independently.
* Establish team\-level mechanisms (e.g., weekly business reviews, program health checks, retrospectives) that drive operational rigor and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges, owning the most critical and cross\-cutting programs.
* Analyze defect trends, abuse patterns, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs and strengthen Amazon's enforcement posture.
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities at scale.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space.
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations making trade\-off recommendations, surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions, and ensuring your team's programs are integrated into the broader Brand Protection strategy.
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Build and maintain deep team\-level expertise in brand abuse and enforcement strategy, ensuring the team can conduct rigorous deep dives to derive insights about emerging abuse vectors across Amazon's worldwide stores.


**About The Team**
 The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Master's degree
* Knowledge of SQL

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Requirement
 
 As the
 **Head of Engineering** 
 , you will work closely with the Founders and CTO to execute the company’s technology strategy and take end\-to\-end ownership of engineering delivery across multiple fintech products. You will convert product requirements and architecture into clear execution plans, lead engineering teams, drive critical fintech integrations, institutionalise AI\-assisted development, and ensure high standards of security, scalability, reliability, auditability, and engineering quality.
 



  




 Core Responsibilities
 
  




 1\. Engineering Management \& Product Delivery
 * Convert the approved architecture, product roadmap, and detailed feature requirements into a clear month\-by\-month engineering execution plan with milestones, dependencies, and delivery checkpoints.
* Plan the technical roadmap with the Founders and CTO in alignment with business priorities.
* Own delivery across multiple products and ensure engineering teams meet agreed timelines, quality standards, and release goals.
* Run effective sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, definition\-of\-done, release management, and staged go\-lives.
* Lead phased product launches, including prioritised delivery of the Mutual Fund core platform.
* Identify technical, delivery, and resource risks early and drive them to resolution.
* Continuously improve engineering processes, productivity, predictability, and delivery quality.



  




 2\. Technology Strategy \& Architecture Execution
 * Understand and align with the broader business and technology vision set by the Founders and CTO.
* Work closely with the CTO and Architect to translate technology strategy and architecture into executable engineering plans.
* Ensure architecture, design principles, coding standards, and technical practices are implemented consistently across teams.
* Balance long\-term scalability and maintainability with short\-term product delivery.
* Act as a trusted engineering escalation point for the CTO and Architect.



  




 3\. Fintech Integrations
 * Own engineering delivery of integrations across the fintech ecosystem, including:
* Stock broking OMS/RMS and back\-office platforms such as Kambala, Omnisys, ODIN, RupeeSeed, or equivalent systems.
* Mutual Fund RTA feed engines.
* CAS parsing and portfolio ingestion.
* Accord Fintech or similar market\-data providers.
* SETU Account Aggregator.
* MF Central and related investment ecosystem platforms.
* Define reliable integration standards for APIs, authentication, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, error handling, monitoring, and support.
* Work with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure integrations are delivered according to the overall roadmap.
* Support bought\-component and third\-party integration strategies without compromising security, reliability, or maintainability.



  




 4\. AI\-Assisted Engineering
 * Institutionalise AI\-assisted software development as a standard engineering practice.
* Drive AI adoption across coding, refactoring, code reviews, test generation, documentation, debugging, and reconciliation automation.
* Define and measure the productivity multiplier achieved through AI\-assisted engineering on a monthly basis.
* Ensure AI tools are used within appropriate security, confidentiality, and engineering\-quality standards.



  




 5\. Security, Reliability \& Multi\-Tenant Platform
 * Own engineering implementation of non\-functional requirements for the multi\-tenant white\-label platform.
* Ensure strong standards for security, data isolation, auditability, uptime, scalability, performance, reliability, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure appropriate tenant\-level isolation and access control across customer and transactional data.
* Support enterprise\-grade RBAC and/or ABAC implementation.
* Ensure systems support regulated\-domain controls such as:
* Audit trails
* Maker\-checker workflows
* Data retention
* Access logging
* Transaction traceability
* Reconciliation
* Collaborate with relevant teams to achieve required security certifications and maintain strong security practices across applications and integrations.



  




 6\. Engineering Quality \& Documentation
 * Establish and maintain strong coding, review, testing, deployment, and release standards.
* Ensure applications are scalable, secure, maintainable, testable, and production\-ready.
* Drive automation across testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and operational workflows.
* Lead code\-level and module\-level documentation by example.
* Ensure APIs, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and operational procedures are properly documented.
* Identify and manage technical debt in a structured manner.



  




 7\. People Management
 * Hire, mentor, develop, and retain a high\-performing engineering team.
* Lead and support a team of approximately 8–15 engineers across relevant engineering functions.
* Conduct regular 1:1s and provide clear feedback, coaching, and growth opportunities.
* Identify skill gaps and arrange appropriate mentoring, training, or hiring.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, learning, and engineering excellence.
* Act as the escalation point for major technical and delivery challenges.



  




 8\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 * Work closely with Product, Architecture, Design, Security, Operations, Data, Compliance, and Business teams.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and major technical decisions clearly to leadership.
* Ensure engineering execution remains aligned with business and product priorities.
* Support company\-wide policies and contribute to creating a productive and collaborative work environment.



  




 Expected Skills
 * Strong technical expertise in backend engineering, APIs, distributed systems, databases, and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with popular technology stacks; C\#, .Net Core, Micro Services, Redis, Rabbit/MSMQ, Kafka, MS SQL/PostgreSQL.
* Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably
 **AWS and/or GCP** 
 .
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, release management, and production operations.
* Working fluency with AI coding and testing tools as a team\-wide engineering practice.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and delivery\-management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to plan strategically while executing aggressively in the short term.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.

 .

 leading multiple developers or engineering teams.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Us** 




 Omega Healthcare Management Services® is an AI\-driven healthcare solutions company that partners across the healthcare ecosystem to deliver breakthrough results by reimagining and elevating revenue operations.
 



 With a global presence spanning four countries, our team of 30,000\+ professionals collaborates with hospitals, physician groups and healthcare providers to streamline operations, improve financial performance and elevate patient care outcomes. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced technology and a customer\-centric approach to deliver innovative, scalable healthcare support solutions.
 



**About the Omega Digital Platform®** 




 The Omega Digital Platform® is our agentic AI engine. It leverages adaptive intelligence to drive automation across the revenue cycle, complemented by deep human expertise, to optimise performance and deliver sustained financial and clinical outcomes.
 



 The platform spans the revenue cycle end to end — patient access and eligibility at the front, documentation and coding integrity through the middle, and revenue recovery at the back — with a shared intelligence layer running beneath all three. Capability built once on the platform is available everywhere on it.
 



**About CollectIQ** 




 CollectIQ is the revenue recovery product of the Omega Digital Platform. It works the accounts receivable a provider has already earned but has not yet collected — denied, underpaid, unanswered and written\-off claims.
 



 Most denied revenue is recoverable, and most of it is never recovered. Not through poor execution, but because the cost of pursuing a claim frequently exceeds what it is expected to return. The binding constraint in back\-end revenue cycle management is claim economics, not staff capacity. Adding people does not solve it; lowering the unit cost of a resolution does, because it makes previously unworkable inventory worth working.
 



 CollectIQ is built on that premise. It is an orchestration product, not a workflow tool — and the distinction defines the work.
 



 A workflow tool assumes the work is human, and exists to make a person faster at a task a person was always going to do. CollectIQ treats the human as one execution path among several — alongside autonomous agents, digital pathways, bots and voice — selected when the economics and the confidence support it. Every claim is assessed, valued, routed to the most efficient sufficient path, resolved, written back to the client system and reconciled, with outcomes feeding back to improve the next decision.
 



 The product is delivered as AI plus human workforce: technology does the work wherever it can, and people take only what genuinely needs judgement. Because Omega performs this work at scale across a large provider base, CollectIQ learns from real resolution outcomes — an advantage very few organisations in this market are positioned to build.
 



**Position** 




**Position Title: Senior Product Manager – CollectIQ** 




 Department: Product Management Group
 



 Location: Hyderabad, India
 



 Reports to: Associate Vice President – Product Management
 



 Role Type: Individual contributor
 



 You will own a product lane within CollectIQ — one or more categories of accounts receivable, taken from zero to one. You will define the problem, scope the solution, ship it with engineering, prove it at a client, and scale it. This is a builder's role, not a backlog\-administration role.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* **Own product strategy for your lane.** 
 Define the vision, roadmap and sequencing. Make build, buy and partner decisions and defend them with evidence.
* **Lead discovery.** 
 Work directly with operations teams, clients and claims data to find where recovery economics break down. Translate ambiguous business problems into scoped, phased product bets.
* **Define AI and automation capabilities end to end.** 
 Specify how work is detected, prioritised, routed, executed and closed — including where a human reviews, approves or overrides the system.
* **Govern autonomy responsibly.** 
 Set confidence thresholds and escalation rules, design how overrides are captured, and expand automation on measured evidence rather than optimism.
* **Write requirements engineering can build from.** 
 PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria grounded in real claim scenarios, with clear definitions of done.
* **Define and instrument success metrics before the build.** 
 Own adoption, resolution quality, unit economics and business impact for your lane — and own building the measurement where it does not yet exist.
* **Partner across functions.** 
 Work with engineering, data science, operations, implementation and client\-facing teams from discovery through go\-live and iteration. Run the agile cadence your team needs.
* **Manage partner and vendor capabilities.** 
 Where we integrate rather than build, define the integration contract, the data terms and the performance bar.
* **Communicate with clarity.** 
 Present direction, trade\-offs, risks and results to senior leadership and clients — precise, concise and free of padding.
* **Stay current.** 
 Track industry movement in revenue cycle automation, agentic AI and payer behaviour, and bring it back into the roadmap.



**Requirements** 




**7\+ years of overall experience, with substantial time as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a product\-led organisation. We are not setting an upper limit. What we assess is what you have built, not how long you have been building.** 




 The differentiator is demonstrated 0→1 ownership — a capability you defined, shipped and grew from nothing into production use. Seniority beyond that is welcome and will be levelled accordingly.
 



**Essential** 



* Proven track record of defining, building, launching and scaling products as an individual contributor.
* Experience with AI\-enabled or data\-driven products: identifying and prioritising automation use cases, partnering with data science and ML teams, and defining success metrics for AI features such as accuracy, adoption and business impact.
* Ability to translate business problems into AI\-assisted workflows — automation, decision support, prioritisation and recommendation.
* Strong data fluency. You interrogate data yourself rather than waiting for a report. SQL or equivalent is a significant plus.
* Technical literacy sufficient to hold your own on APIs, data flows, integration patterns and system design. You need not be an engineer, but you must be credible with them.
* Fluency in agile product development — Scrum and Kanban — with sound judgement on scope and schedule trade\-offs.
* Exceptional written communication. You will be assessed on a written product document, not a deck.
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, with high ownership and a bias for action.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA is a plus.



**Preferred** 



* Product experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with exposure to accounts receivable, denials, appeals, underpayments or claim lifecycle workflows.
* Working understanding of payer adjudication behaviour, denial taxonomy and claim data standards.
* Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, HIPAA and compliance considerations in healthcare environments.
* Experience with enterprise workflow platforms, analytics systems or orchestration products.



*Healthcare domain experience is preferred but not required. We are equally open to strong product builders from other domains. We will teach the domain — we are not looking to teach product fundamentals.*

title: Product Lead - Private Credit (Direct Lending)
description:
Arcesium seeks a Product Lead with deep private credit expertise to build and evolve our Private Credit capabilities. This is an individual contributor role, working closely with Engineering, Client \& Partner Development, Sales, and Marketing. The product spans the deal\-close and post\-close lifecycle, including deal onboarding, portfolio monitoring, covenant and borrowing\-base management, loan administration, reporting, and related workflows.
 



  





 Location : HYD/BLR/GGM
 



  





**What you'll do:** 



* Execute the Private Credit product roadmap, translating product strategy, client needs, and domain knowledge into requirements and prioritized capabilities.
* Own product definition and design, working with Engineering and QA through development, testing, launch, and iteration.
* Work with clients and design partners to validate product direction and translate recurring needs into scalable capabilities.
* Develop business scenarios, test cases, and validation models to ensure the product handles real\-world private credit structures and calculations correctly.
* Take new capabilities from prototype through production readiness and broader client adoption.
* Partner with Sales, Pre\-Sales, Forward Deployed, and Marketing on positioning, demonstrations, client discussions, and go\-to\-market.
* Contribute to competitive analysis, business cases, and prioritization of R\&D investments.
* Prototype workflows, calculations, and automation using AI\-assisted coding and modern development tools.
* Define AI\-enabled capabilities for interpreting credit agreements, compliance certificates, borrower reporting, trustee reports, and other private credit documents.



  





**What you'll need:** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on private credit experience, with meaningful exposure to the lifecycle, documentation, calculations, and workflows of private credit investments; product management experience is an advantage.
* Strong depth in one or more areas of private credit, with direct lending experience particularly valuable; experience in asset\-based finance, structured credit, or adjacent credit strategies is also relevant — spanning unitranche, senior or subordinated lending, delayed\-draw facilities, revolvers, asset\-based lending, specialty finance, CRE lending, ABS, CLOs, or loan portfolios.
* Working knowledge of covenant monitoring and testing, compliance certificates, breaches, waivers, and amendments; borrowing bases, advance rates, collateral eligibility, concentration limits, and reserves; and loan lifecycle events including drawdowns, paydowns, prepayments, PIK, OID, assignments, and participations.
* Familiarity with cash waterfalls, priority of payments, OC/IC tests, triggers, and portfolio or collateral surveillance.
* Ability to read credit agreements and related reporting and determine what a product needs to capture, calculate, validate, and monitor.
* Strong Excel and financial\-modeling skills, including independent validation of covenants, borrowing bases, waterfalls, or similar calculations.
* Ability to work directly with data; SQL experience is strongly preferred, with familiarity in scripting, APIs, or low\-code tools an advantage.
* Experience with platforms such as Wall Street Office, Allvue, Solvas, iLEVEL, or similar systems, preferred.
* Experience with generative AI tools for prototyping, or a demonstrated aptitude to use them effectively.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, computer science, or a related field preferred; CFA, CA, MBA, FRM, or similar qualifications are an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain complex credit concepts clearly.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Techdome**
 Techdome is a technology\-driven company that builds innovative solutions to help clients solve complex problems and stand out in their markets. Our team of technical experts and domain specialists works together to deliver software that makes a real difference, increasingly powered by AI.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Product Manager with strong technical understanding, practical AI exposure, cross\-functional team experience, and knowledge of multiple industry domains to lead projects from kickoff to delivery, on time, on budget, and on target.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and budgets with stakeholders, making sure plans are technically feasible and aligned with business goals.
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams across UI/UX design, frontend, backend, and mobile development, QA, DevOps, and business analysis, ensuring smooth handoffs and alignment at every stage.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of software and AI/ML projects (LLM integrations, chatbots, AI agents, automation), working closely with engineers, data scientists, and ML specialists.
* Understand each client's industry quickly and translate domain and compliance requirements into clear technical deliverables.
* Manage internal resources and third\-party vendors, including allocation, contract negotiation, and performance accountability.
* Run structured change control for scope, schedule, and cost, and proactively identify and mitigate technical, delivery, and AI\-specific risks.
* Track project performance in JIRA or Azure DevOps and present regular status reports to management and clients.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive, transparent communication.
* Maintain complete and accessible project documentation, and use AI tools to make reporting and planning more efficient.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years as a Product Manager on technology or software projects, with a proven record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Proven experience working with cross\-functional teams (design, development, QA, DevOps), with a clear understanding of how each function works and how to keep them in sync.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall methodologies, and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Strong technical understanding of the SDLC, system architecture (APIs, microservices, databases), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, with the confidence to join technical discussions and question estimates.
* Practical exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI projects, with an understanding of the AI lifecycle (data, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and its risks (privacy, bias, hallucinations, cost).
* Experience across multiple domains, such as FinTech, Healthcare, E\-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, or SaaS, with the ability to learn new domains and their compliance standards quickly.
* Strong skills in risk and change management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Deep expertise in at least one industry domain.


**Why Join Techdome?**
* Lead AI\-driven, technically challenging projects across diverse industries.
* Work alongside experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts, with real ownership over how projects are run.

 At dsm\-firmenich we strive to achieve a world where you don’t have to choose between taste, texture, or health \- and can enjoy it all. Our innovative ingredients, expertise, and solutions bridge the gap between the delicious, the nutritious, and the sustainable.
   

  

 The ServiceNow Business Analyst is accountable for translating business needs, process requirements, and stakeholder priorities into clear, actionable requirements for the ServiceNow platform.This role ensures that ServiceNow enhancements, implementations, and platform changes are well defined, business aligned, user focused, and delivered in line with governance, SIAM operating models, and enterprise standards.
   

  

 Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.
   

  

 At dsm\-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting our People, Customers \& Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Analysis \& Requirements Management
* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out\-of\-the\-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.
* Support demand intake, impact assessment, scope definition, and change prioritization across ServiceNow modules.
* Process Design \& ServiceNow Solution Alignment
* Analyze current\-state processes and support the design of future\-state workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.
* Backlog, Delivery \& Testing Support
* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.
* Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement walkthroughs, build clarifications, and functional reviews.
* Define and support test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Track requirement traceability from demand through design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Governance, Controls \& Change Readiness
* Ensure requirements and process designs comply with ServiceNow governance, security, data, audit, and compliance standards.
* Support impact assessments for platform changes, releases, integrations, and process changes.
* Prepare business stakeholders for adoption through process documentation, training inputs, communication support, and transition readiness activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, open decisions, and requirement gaps early and drive timely resolution.
* Reporting, Insights \& Continuous Improvement
* Use ServiceNow data, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continual service improvement initiatives focused on user experience, automation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Contribute to roadmap inputs by identifying recurring pain points, process bottlenecks, and value opportunities.
* Promote data\-driven decisions and measurable business outcomes from ServiceNow delivery.
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Collaboration
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, process owners, platform owners, architects, SIAM teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, demos, and decision discussions with clear documentation and follow\-through.
* Coordinate with system integrators and internal teams to clarify scope, resolve requirement questions, and validate delivery outputs.
* Act as a trusted functional advisor to stakeholders on ServiceNow process and requirement topics.


**We bring**
* A supportive environment where you’re empowered to grow and share your ideas.
* An inclusive and multicultural team with respect for everyone
* A dynamic work environment with many challenges that give you the possibility to work autonomously and with a team in finding the right solutions.


**You bring**
* 6\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in enterprise IT platforms.
* Strong experience working with ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, or platform operations.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB; exposure to HRSD, CSM, SPM, ITOM, GRC, or Legal Service Delivery is an advantage.
* Proven ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business requirements, and functional specifications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, UAT, and release support.
* Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance business value, user experience, process standardization, governance, and delivery practicality.

title: Project Director - Product Development
description:
**Scope**
* Lead a team of software engineers within the Returns Development organization, providing technical direction, people leadership, execution discipline, and coaching.
* Partner closely with Product Management, UX, Cloud Operations, Support, and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality returns capabilities aligned to roadmap commitments and customer outcomes.
* Drive enterprise engineering practices that improve quality, scalability, reliability, performance, security, maintainability, and operational readiness across services and applications.


**What You’ll Do**
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, creating clarity of priorities, accountability, and growth opportunities.
* Own delivery execution for assigned Returns Development roadmap commitments, ensuring predictable planning, high\-quality delivery, and transparent communication of progress, risks, and dependencies.
* Provide technical leadership in design and implementation discussions, helping the team make sound architectural decisions for scalable, performant, secure, and maintainable solutions.
* Partner with Product Management to translate roadmap priorities, customer needs, and business outcomes into well\-defined engineering plans and releases.
* Drive Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, execution tracking, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
* Improve engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, CI/CD practices, observability, operational readiness, defect reduction, and root cause analysis.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies with adjacent product, platform, cloud, support, and implementation teams to ensure successful end\-to\-end solution delivery.
* Support customer escalations and production issues by ensuring timely technical investigation, clear communication, and durable corrective actions.
* Build team capability through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, and succession planning.
* Use data, KPIs, and engineering metrics to assess team health, delivery performance, quality trends, and opportunities for improvement.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience building solutions for complex problems.
* Proven experience leading delivery of enterprise\-grade SaaS, cloud\-hosted, or cloud\-native applications at scale.
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architecture, collaborate on design, and troubleshoot delivery decisions; prior hands\-on software development experience is required.
* Experience with microservices, APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and modern DevOps practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead Agile teams and manage planning, execution, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
* Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, hiring, and developing engineering talent.
* Quality\-first mindset with experience using engineering metrics, production insights, and root cause analysis to improve product and team outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively with global, cross\-functional teams and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Supply chain, warehouse, returns, inventory, commerce, or logistics domain experience is preferred.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: HCLS Solutions lead IRC302899
description:
**Description**
 Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real\-world healthcare challenges, and launching data\-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
   

  

 15\+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
   

  

 Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
   

  

 Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C\+\+, JAVA, C\#, etc)
   

  

 Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
   

  

 Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
   

  

 Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
   

  

 English proficiency at Advanced level.
   

  

 Good presentation and demonstration skills
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
   

  

 Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
   

  

 Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
   

  

 Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility \& value.
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
   

  

 Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare\-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
   

  

 Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
   

  

 Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Product Analyst - Hyderabad

**Position Summary**
**Product Analyst**

 This includes detailed analysis of performance of search terms, studying user behavior trends and custom outreach. This also entails recommendations for content optimization and acquisition.

* Postgraduate degree and 1\-2 years of professional work experience.

* Experience using Microsoft Excel formulas and functions for data analysis.
* Experience using Adobe Analytics, Omniture, or SiteCatalyst.
* Experience using Azure DevOps and software testing lifecycle processes.

title: Associate Director - BI Reporting and AI Engineering Principal
description:
**Overview**
 The AI Engineering Principal is responsible for leading the design, development, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI and GenAI solutions. This role drives the end\-to\-end delivery of AI products, agentic applications, intelligent automation capabilities, and analytics solutions that create measurable business value.
   

  

 The position works closely with business stakeholders, product managers, data scientists, data engineers, and platform teams to transform AI use cases into production\-ready solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering practices with deep expertise in AI/ML, GenAI, cloud platforms, and enterprise architecture.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 AI Solution Delivery
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI, ML, and Generative AI solutions.
* Build scalable AI applications, copilots, intelligent assistants, and agent\-based systems.
* Translate business use cases into production\-ready AI products and services.
* Drive technical decisions across architecture, frameworks, tools, and deployment patterns.


 AI Platform \& Engineering
   

  

* Establish reusable AI engineering frameworks, accelerators, and best practices.
* Drive adoption of AI platforms, LLMs, vector databases, RAG architectures, and agent frameworks.
* Develop robust API, microservices, and integration patterns supporting AI workloads.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and cost optimized.


 MLOps / LLMOps
   

  

* Define standards for model lifecycle management, monitoring, observability, and governance.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for AI applications and machine learning models.
* Establish evaluation frameworks for LLM quality, safety, performance, and reliability.
* Drive responsible AI, security, compliance, and risk management practices.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Provide technical direction and mentorship to AI engineers and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead architecture reviews and engineering governance discussions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Build engineering roadmaps aligned with enterprise AI strategy.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with product, business, analytics, and technology leaders to prioritize initiatives.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to executive and non\-technical audiences.
* Manage delivery expectations, risks, dependencies, and outcomes across multiple projects.


**Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Experience**
* 14\+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or AI/ML engineering experience.
* 10\+ years leading enterprise\-scale AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI initiatives.
* Proven experience delivering AI products from ideation through production deployment.
* Experience working with global teams and enterprise stakeholders.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong programming skills in Python and modern engineering frameworks.
* Experience with Large Language Models (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.).
* Expertise in RAG, agentic AI systems, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with Databricks, Azure AI Services, AWS AI/ML services, or equivalent cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of vector databases, embeddings, knowledge retrieval, and semantic search.
* Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, model monitoring, and governance frameworks.


 Leadership Skills
   

  

* Strong strategic and systems\-thinking mindset.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to mentor and grow high\-performing engineering teams.
* Strong communication and executive presentation capabilities.


**Preferred Experience**
* Enterprise AI platform development.
* Copilot and AI assistant development.
* Agentic AI and autonomous workflow solutions.
* AI governance, security, and Responsible AI practices.
* Experience building reusable AI engineering capabilities across multiple business domains.

title: CustomerTech - MobileTech - IT Delivery - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
**Manager II, IT Delivery**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* A technically orietnted leader who is familiar with AWS, CI/CD Pipelines (Github) TDD/BDD practices, user level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb. Familiarity leading a MS Dynamics team is a plus.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Github Co\-Pilot is a plus
* Previous people leadership experience.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Product Owner III
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
 


  


 By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
 


  






  




**Role Overview:** 
  


 PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help manage multiple simultaneous projects and issues of varying size, end to end, within our Loyalty engine ecosystem. The Product Owner (PO) is a critical member of an Agile development team that drives the team to deliver high\-quality, high\-value features and functions in service of our Loyalty business.
 


  


 As a PO, you will help shape product features and requirements while working closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to build high\-quality products for our target markets. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles — ideally with exposure to loyalty, rewards, or CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms — is highly desired.
 


  


 This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements\-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
 


  


  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

  
* **Stay aligned with and contribute to** 
 the Loyalty product vision, roadmap, and priorities
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer\-reported issues within the Loyalty ecosystem
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand business needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI\-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new Loyalty features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Loyalty initiatives
  

  


  


  




**Qualifications:** 
  

  
* Ability to connect technical system behavior (rules engines, transaction/redemption flows, integrations) with business goals for the Loyalty program
  
* Comfort working within a complex, rules\-driven engine where changes can have wide\-reaching downstream effects
  
* Experience with loyalty, rewards, promotions, or CRM platforms is a strong plus
  
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI\-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast\-paced environment
  
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non\-technical terms and vice versa
  
* Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high\-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
  
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
  
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
  
* Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions
  
* Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross\-time\-zone communication habits
  
* Working knowledge of product and sprint backlog tracking, burn\-down metrics, velocity, and work breakdown techniques
  
* Solid understanding of Agile software development processes and principles
  
* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or equivalent work experience
  

  


  


  




**Preferred Skills:** 
  

  
* Domain experience in Convenience Retail, ERP, Logistics, or Financial transaction processing solutions
  

  


  


  




**Behavioral Competencies:** 
  

  
* Ensures Accountability
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Communicates Effectively
  
* Balances Stakeholders
  
* Collaborates Effectively
  

  


  





  




  


 PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
 


  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

 Product Discovery \& Capability Support
   

  

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.

* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).


 Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.


 Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)
   

  

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.


 Agile Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.
* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.


 Stakeholder Communication \& Influence
   

  

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.


**What are we looking for?**
 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
 **pursue greatness** 
 ,
 **act with integrity** 
 , and are
 **driven to help our clients succeed** 
 . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
 **win together** 
 and
 **create and share joy** 
 in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)
* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis

* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.

**Preferences**

title: Applied AI Product Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Manager**
**Overview**
**Job Description**
 An Applied AI Product Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-functional product teams to solve moderate complexity customer problems that align with high value business needs. The Applied AI Product Manager is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. The Applied AI Product Manager harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy\-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
* Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Vision and Strategy
* Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
* Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
* Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.
* Use AI to expedite research, gather evidence, bolster domain knowledge, and craft and innovative visions backed by compelling strategic rationale.
* Market and User Engagement
* Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
* Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.
* Apply analytical skills to analyze data and derive actionable insights, shifting from waiting on analysis to working on insights.
* Adopt innovative and experimental approaches to solving complex problems, including AI\-built, disposable prototypes that validate solutions quickly and retire bad ideas just as fast.
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Work side\-by\-side with cross\-functional (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
* Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
* Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership and level\-up their outcome potential through AI and agentic tools.
* Continuous Improvement
* Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
* Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force\-multiplier to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
* Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
* Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.
* Applied AI Ways of Working
* Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—charting new pathways for the business.
* Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compressing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chief—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
* Amplify experimentation: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path to productionize early and often.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of proven experience in lean product management or related roles.
* 3\+ years enterprise scale experience across multiple business areas.
* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Preferred Education: An MBA or related advanced degree is preferred.
* Preferred Experience:
* Demonstrated experience in modern product craft of delivering the right thing, in the right way, at the right time. Significant experience in lean product management craft and domain (tools, methods, and practices). Seen as a leader in this space.
* Proven accountability for value, viability and P\&L objectives for a product and for an empowered product team.
* Preferred Skills
* Communication: Clear and effective communication with team members, stakeholders, and customers. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and collective movement toward product goals. Ability to influence at all organizational levels through inclusion and leadership.
* Customer\-Centricity: Deep understanding of customer needs and engagement patterns, driving teams to deliver solutions that customers love and that work for the business. Expertise in applying customer\-centric methods and practices.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for the product, aligning it with broader business objectives.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and visionary.
* Learning\-forward, experimental, and value\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to navigate complexity and uncertainty.
* Quick to reach expert\-level knowledge within the product domain being served.
* AI Agentic Fluency: Comfortable orchestrating multiple AI agents across the concept\-to\-cash flow (research, insight, prototyping, specification, coding, and compliance), with guardrails at each hand\-off—assumptions, confidence levels, and links to sources of truth.
* AI Realism and Eval Fluency: Understands the difference between deterministic logic and probabilistic generation; designs guardrails for hallucination, bias, and drift; uses evaluation harnesses before launch and monitors drift after, with a kill\-switch mentality—and knows when not to use AI.
* Experience with modern agentic AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude Co\-work, Open AI Codex Cursor, and Visual Studio Code.
* Preferred Personal Traits
* Strong leadership capabilities.
* Customer\-centric mindset.
* Ability to work as an individual contributor in a collaborative, cross\-functional team.
* Humble, curious, and learning\-forward mindset.
* Favor small step action and evidence over detailed upfront planning and precision aiming.
* Experience with lean solutions and rapid, inexpensive experimentation to emerge the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* High levels of continuous customer and user engagement.
* Treats taste and judgment as the un\-automatable moat—using AI to amplify, never replace, product sense\-making.


**Conclusion**
 The Applied AI Product Manager plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our high value, moderately complex products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands significant experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.

description:
