title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

**Job Overview**
 LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.
   

  

 The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

 Product Discovery \& Capability Support

 Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.

 Agile Execution \& Delivery

 Stakeholder Communication \& Influence
   

  

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.

* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.

title: Senior Product Manager - GP & Client Experience (ADI)
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the
 **GP and client experience** 
 within ADI — the experiences our fund\-manager clients use to run and monitor their business: the client operations centre where they track the progress of their work, their dashboards and reporting, and the client portal. You will own the roadmap and the end\-to\-end product management for this stream. The first use cases go live in October 2026; your job is to build on them and
 **own the future roadmap** 
 that takes the GP experience to its full vision.
   

  

 You will translate the reality of fund administration — across private equity, private credit and real assets — into a clear, consolidated, self\-service experience, turning information that today lives in many places into a single, trustworthy view for clients. You will work hands\-on: authoring executable PRDs and building the first prototypes yourself, then partnering with engineering, design and client\-delivery teams to bring them to production.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Product strategy \& roadmap**
* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the GP \& client experience — including the future roadmap well beyond the first use cases — and converge the platform toward its full product vision.
* Prioritise a single backlog against client value, commercial impact and key\-client risk; make trade\-offs visible and take decisions at pace.


**The GP Experience**
* Own the client operations centre (where clients monitor the progress of their tasks), the client dashboards and reporting experience, and the client portal — defining the journeys, information design and self\-service capabilities.
* Define the single ‘one\-lens’ view across funds and asset classes — bringing valuations, capital calls and distributions, portfolio monitoring, and fund and investor reporting into one coherent client experience.


**Domain \& data**
* Understand how client\-facing information — valuations, cash flows, positions and reporting — is produced across the fund\-accounting, portfolio and reporting estate, and ensure it reaches clients as a single, trustworthy view.
* Work with data and platform teams to define what information the experience needs and where it is sourced, and manage the move from legacy portals so that no client is left behind.


**Building AI\-Native — How We Work**
* Author Executable PRDs (xPRDs) — structured context repositories that combine natural\-language intent, machine\-actionable specification, complete business and technical context, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria, and embedded governance guardrails.
* Build the first functional prototype yourself during ideation and discovery, using AI tooling to validate desirability (product\-market fit with clients) and feasibility (with architects) in parallel — then hand a high\-fidelity, context\-rich prototype to engineering to curate and take to production quality.
* Own the non\-functional requirements — performance, availability, scalability, security and accessibility — from day one, treating them as first\-class product requirements rather than an afterthought.
* Work within an enhanced design\-thinking approach with governance embedded from day one — ethical AI and user rights, privacy, security, risk and compliance, and audit/traceability — alongside explicit attention to data readiness (maturity, availability and quality).


**Delivery \& cross\-functional**
* Act as product lead across the relevant delivery teams; partner with technology and architecture on delivery, and with client\-delivery and commercial teams on adoption and client engagement.


**Essential**
**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE:**
* Proven senior product management experience delivering client\-facing B2B software, portals or data/reporting products with measurable customer and commercial impact.
* Demonstrated ability to work AI\-native — authoring structured, executable PRDs and building functional prototypes with AI tooling.
* Strong experience with dashboards, reporting and data\-visualisation products, and a sharp instinct for information design and self\-service experience.
* Excellent prioritisation, stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity from ambiguity.


**Desirable**
* Domain experience in fund administration, asset servicing or alternatives (private equity, private credit, real assets).
* Familiarity with the fund\-accounting, portfolio and reporting systems that produce client information (such as Investran, eFront, Yardi, Solvas and ReportPro).
* Experience in agile, multi\-team delivery and large product platforms.


**Personal Attributes**
* Outcome\-driven and client\-centric, keeping the client journey at the centre of every decision.
* Hands\-on and comfortable prototyping; happy to build, not just specify.
* Collaborative and influential across product, technology, design, operations and commercial teams.


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager \- Live Services** 




  





**About Us** 




 Liquidnitro Games is a game development company built to create, launch, and scale ambitious games for a global audience.
 



 Founded by industry veterans with deep experience across free\-to\-play, live services, and large\-scale game production agnostic of platforms, we bring together product thinking, design craft, engineering depth, art execution, data, and live operations under one roof.
 



 We build games from the ground up, take new ideas from 0 to 1, and work with select partners to strengthen, scale, and operate high\-quality game experiences. Our teams combine creative ownership with production discipline, helping projects move from early prototypes to validated products, and from launch to long\-term growth.
 



 At Liquidnitro, we are building the next generation of game teams, products, and tools from India for the global games industry.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager** 
 to join a team operating and growing a live game.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of players, product, data, design, and live operations. You will help understand how players engage with the game, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and work with cross\-functional teams to turn those insights into product changes, features, events, and experiments.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between data and gameplay, understanding both what the numbers are telling us and what is happening inside the game. The goal is not just to report performance, but to understand why players behave the way they do and what we should do next.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Analyse player behaviour across retention, engagement, progression, monetization, and live events.
* Build a strong understanding of the game's core loop, progression systems, economy, content, and player segments.
* Identify product opportunities and translate them into clear hypotheses and recommendations.
* Work closely with Product Management, Game Design, Analytics, Production, Engineering, and other cross functional teams to improve the game.
* Support the design and evaluation of features, events, offers, progression changes, and monetization initiatives.
* Define success metrics for product changes and evaluate performance after launch.
* Design and analyse A/B tests and other experiments.
* Use cohort and segmentation analysis to understand differences in player behaviour.
* Investigate changes in KPIs and identify the underlying causes rather than stopping at surface\-level reporting.
* Review the performance of live events and features and recommend changes based on player behaviour and outcomes.
* Track competitive games, market trends, and relevant product mechanics.
* Contribute to product roadmap and live\-ops planning based on player needs, game performance, and business priorities.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both product and development teams.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management – preferably in gaming or consumer related products.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work with data and convert analysis into actionable product decisions.
* Understanding of free\-to\-play game metrics such as retention, engagement, conversion, ARPDAU, and LTV.
* Strong interest in games and a good instinct for player experience.
* Ability to think in hypotheses, test assumptions, and measure outcomes.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and communicating with both creative and technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and curiosity about why systems and players behave the way they do.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience working on a live mobile or free\-to\-play game.
* Working knowledge of SQL and BI or analytics tools.
* Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis, and player segmentation.
* Understanding of game economies, progression systems, rewards, and monetization.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 You are able to move beyond reporting that a metric changed and explain why it changed, which players were affected, what part of the game caused it, and what we should do next.
 



 Over time, you should develop enough understanding of the game and its players to independently identify product opportunities, build a case for them using data and player insight, and help drive them from hypothesis through implementation and measurement.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Product (Travel)
description:
**Why are we building Nuclei?**
 Before we started Nuclei, we listed down a few guiding principles. These were essentially our learning from previous startups/companies:
   

  

* Think big, think global, and not limit ourselves only to India.
* Build a company. We wanted to be sustainable from day 1 and build a profitable business. This does not mean that we compromise on growth, but we most definitely avoid unsustainable growth.
* Build for the long term, not flip it in a few years.
* And most importantly, we wanted to change the perception about India, from being a back\-office/outsourcing destination, to a product destination.


 All the above points came together to form Nuclei's vision — "To build a well respected global product company." At Nuclei, we are building innovative products that help enterprises increase customer engagement and build deeper relationships with their customers, by offering value\-added services like travel and gifting ecosystems.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As part of this vision, we're building a full travel ecosystem including Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe, and expanding this proposition across multiple markets in Europe. This particular EIR seat sits within that travel team. You'll take ownership of category features and initiatives from first identifying the problem through to launch and iteration, working closely with the rest of the product, design, and engineering team.
   

  

**Please note: This is a remote job.**
**Who should apply?**
* Someone with 3 to 5 years of product building experience
* We're looking for product builders who can go 0→1 as well as 1→10 — building something new, and then scaling it through product\-led growth, journey optimization, and continuous iteration. It's not just build and forget.
* Prior experience in a startup would be preferred
* Founder or entrepreneurial experience is strongly preferred for this role — whether that's starting a company, being an early team member somewhere, or building a meaningful project of your own from scratch
* We have a strong preference for candidates with prior experience in travel, marketplace, or high\-volume consumer products


**Who are Product Builders?**
* Product Builders don't get hassled by chaos and constant change, they actually enjoy it and thrive in it. They understand that this is necessary for success.
* Product Builders work on building products from scratch (0 to 1\).
* Product Builders have a high bias for action.
* Product Builders think from first principles.


**What will you do?**
* Own category features and initiatives within our Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, product from problem definition through to launch and iteration.
* Translate customer problems and business inputs into clear requirements and prototypes. Scope and prioritize your own work based on customer and business impact.
* Work closely with the engineers, designers, and analysts who care deeply about their product. Should be able to quickly build rapport with them.
* Understand the tech that goes behind the product like data flow among systems, tech bottlenecks, and RCAs when things break.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, and drive product\-led growth initiatives \- journey optimization, activation, retention \- to keep pushing your category forward.
* Plan your features in smaller sprints while staying aware of the larger vision for the travel product and hold a high bar for quality. We're building a world\-class consumer product, so both the customer journey and the underlying tech need to be top\-notch.

description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 The Technical Marketing Engineer for AMD\-AECG is an adaptable, self\-motivated individual who drives the Vivado and next\-generation tool product roadmap to best serve customer needs. This role is responsible for feature specification, planning, validation, documentation, early training materials, and key customer support. Technical Marketing works closely with Product Planning, R\&D, Applications Engineering, and top\-tier customers to improve the FPGA and Adaptive SoC design process and enable next\-generation designs and methodologies. The environment is fast\-moving, global, and focused on emerging technologies.
   

  

 THE PERSON
   

  

 The successful Technical Marketing Engineer plays a critical role in defining, planning, and supporting Programming File Generation and Hardware Debug in the Vivado Design Suite for AMD FPGA and Adaptive SoC products. This includes driving the programming file generation flow and the in\-system debug experience through Vivado Hardware Manager, Integrated Logic Analyzer (ILA), Virtual I/O (VIO), and readback/verification.
   

  

 This person understands customer needs and pain points across bring\-up and silicon debug, and helps define the next generation of the tool roadmap. The ability to manage competing priorities is essential. We operate with an agentic, AI\-first mindset and expect team members to actively incorporate AI into how they work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define best\-in\-class programming file generation and hardware debug flows, features, and methodologies for AMD FPGA, Zynq, and Adaptive SoC tools and libraries.
* Drive the programming file generation flow and in\-system debug capabilities, including Hardware Manager, ILA, VIO, and readback, from specification through validation.
* Lead field escalation response for critical debug and programming tool failures in production environments.
* Own toolchain integration with third\-party development and production test environments.
* Collaborate with R\&D on new device support and bring\-up validation for debug and programming tools.
* Partner with Engineering, Sales, Planning, and Customers to define and deliver tool features.
* Provide technical expertise to the field and customers through training materials, tutorials, and user guides, and mentor Field Applications Engineers.
* Communicate complex topics clearly to field teams and customers, including options, tradeoffs, and impact.
* Evaluate field and customer feedback, identify high\-priority feature gaps and improvements, and work with Planning and Engineering to drive fixes.

* Strong knowledge of the full FPGA design process and tool flow.
* Working knowledge of programming file generation and in\-system hardware debug flows, including ILA/VIO and readback, or similar methodologies.
* Experience with field escalations, toolchain integration, and production test environments.
* Expertise in system\-on\-chip development.
* Experience applying AI/ML tools and techniques, such as AI\-assisted design, debug, automation, or agentic workflows.
* Ability to analyze and solve complex system\-level issues, independently and in collaboration with top\-tier customers.
* Excellent written communication and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with global teams

title: Manager - Engineering
description:

 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For…**
 ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people\-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI\-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 You’ll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full\-time employees and, covering responsibilities across:
   

  

**People \& Growth**
* Conduct regular 1:1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support.
* Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires.
* Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor\-to\-FTE conversion process.
* Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review.
* Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics.
* Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure.


**Delivery \& Execution**
* Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope.
* Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning.
* Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding.
* Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders.


**Technical Leadership**
* Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work.
* Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Sponsoring and helping lead cross\-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release\-process automation.
* Running demo sessions and hands\-on skill\-building with the team on key technical areas.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance.
* Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI\-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems.
* Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands\-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle.


**Org Design**
* Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally\-led working groups.
* A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time.


**Qualities you possess…**
* Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3\-5 years leading engineering teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed.
* Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first\-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet.
* Self\-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Technical Competence:
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems.
* Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks.
* Proficiency in database technologies and event\-driven architecture.
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI\-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade\-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work.
* Leadership \& Management:
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high\-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross\-team coordination.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership.


**As a plus, you have...**
* Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment.
* Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks.
* Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains.
* Engineering background with hands\-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud\-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React.
* Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI\-DLC) and or TDD


*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*

+ Conduct detailed analysis of enterprise data domains and datasets

+ Conduct data profiling, data mapping, data modelling, validation, and business rule analysis.
+ Analyze external providers datasets to assess quality, coverage, and business applicability.
+ Research industry trends, external data sources, and emerging capabilities relevant to MCO's enterprise data strategy.
+ Perform comparative analysis of data providers, enrichment opportunities, and potential data solutions.

+ Support initiatives related to:
- Master Data Management (MDM)
- Reference Data Management
- Data Governance
- Data Quality Management
- Data De\-Duplication

+ Identify opportunities to improve product processes, data quality, and operational efficiency.
+ Contribute ideas for enhancing Enterprise Data capabilities and services.
+ Stay informed on industry trends, data management practices, and emerging technologies.
+ Promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

+ Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Data Management, or a related field.

+ Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the India market.

**Job Description**
**Associate Director — Commercial AI – Tech Lead, Digital Human Health**
****Job Description****
 This role sits within the Commercial AI vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), which is responsible for building and scaling AI capabilities across cross\-functional teams and divisions. The team operates as an embedded strategic partner to the commercial organization, providing thought leadership and delivering AI\-powered solutions to marketing and cross\-functional stakeholders. It shapes demand by translating business priorities into scalable AI products and agent\-driven solutions that enhance decision\-making and drive measurable business impact.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 As the Associate Director – Commercial AI Tech Lead, you will define and lead the technical vision, architecture, and engineering execution for AI and Agentic AI products supporting our company’s Commercial use cases in India. You will play a pivotal role in building and scaling enterprise\-grade AI solutions, including LLM\-powered and agent\-based systems, from rapid prototyping through production deployment.You will establish robust engineering foundations, including reusable frameworks, SDKs, and best practices across LLMOps/MLOps, while ensuring governance, scalability, and compliance. This role requires close collaboration with commercial stakeholders, product and program leaders, enterprise architecture, and risk, security, and privacy teams to deliver impactful, business\-aligned solutions.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Own the reference architecture for Commercial AI \+ Agentic AI solutions, including patterns for RAG, orchestration, tool integration, identity, and observability across environments.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery discover → design → build → deploy → monitor → iterate; ensure production readiness (performance, reliability, security, cost).
* Engineer and ship agentic workflows (planning/reasoning, tool/function calling, reflection, memory patterns, guardrails) and harden them into enterprise\-grade services.
* Establish LLMOps/MLOps operating practices versioning/registry, automated evaluation, safe rollout/rollback, monitoring, and continuous improvement loops.
* Build and maintain reusable capabilities (templates, SDKs, integration patterns, deployment scaffolds) that accelerate delivery across multiple commercial products/teams.
* Drive governance and risk controls in partnership with security/privacy/legal responsible AI, data privacy, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and policy\-based enforcement where needed.
* Implement evaluation \& quality frameworks for LLM/agent systems (offline \+ online), including guardrail testing, prompt/retrieval regression tests, and business KPI alignment.
* Own observability for AI services tracing across prompt → retrieval/tool calls → response, cost/usage dashboards, incident triage, postmortems, and reliability improvements.
* Optimize latency, quality, and cost trade\-offs through caching, prompt/RAG tuning, model routing, and systematic performance benchmarking.
* Partner with business/product leaders to translate commercial problems into well\-scoped AI roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable platform components.
* Ensure solutions align with SDLC \+ validation expectations appropriate for regulated environments; embed documentation and controls into delivery.
* Mentor and lead engineers/data scientists design reviews, coding standards, coaching, hiring input, and building a high\-performing delivery culture.


**Technical Expertise**
**Agentic AI**
* Hands\-on experience designing multi\-step agents with planning, tool/function calling, orchestration, and reflection loops.
* Strong understanding of memory patterns (short\-term, long\-term, episodic), grounding strategies, and failure\-mode handling (loops, hallucinations, tool errors).
* Ability to implement guardrails policy enforcement, prompt injection defenses, tool\-use constraints, HITL checkpoints, and safe fallbacks.
* Expertise in agent evaluation task success scoring, trajectory analysis, tool\-call accuracy, safety checks, and regression automation.


**LLM Engineering**
* Proven experience with prompt engineering patterns, structured outputs, and reliability techniques (self\-checks, constrained decoding, schemas).
* Deep practical knowledge of RAG ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, context assembly, and grounding metrics.
* Understanding of embeddings and vector databases and how to tune retrieval for precision/recall in enterprise settings.
* Awareness of fine\-tuning approaches (when/why; trade\-offs) and model selection strategies for regulated enterprise use.
* Strong focus on latency/cost optimization and observability for GenAI systems (tracing \+ cost controls \+ quality monitoring).
* Experience with Enterprise AI engine – DataBricks AIBI, DataIku AI and Others
* Architecture, Integration \& Platform Thinking
* Ability to define reference architectures for commercial AI solutions and scalable design patterns for multiple products/markets.
* Experience integrating AI/agent services with enterprise applications/APIs, authentication/authorization, logging, and audit trails.
* Strong cloud\-native engineering containers, orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and reliability practices.


**Governance, Risk \& Responsible AI**
* Working knowledge of model governance documentation, validation, monitoring, auditability, and human oversight suitable for regulated environments.
* Data privacy/security\-by\-design access controls, encryption, secure secrets, and collaboration with InfoSec for audits and risk management.


****Education Requirements****
 Masters (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline with strong focus on AI/ML and modern data systems.
   

  

****Required Experience And Skills****
* 8\+ years in relevant experience across software engineering, ML engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, or AI product engineering, with hands on experience of production deployments at scale.
* 4\+ years leading teams and driving delivery across multiple stakeholders; proven ability to mentor and raise engineering standards.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python, API/service development, and modern engineering workflows (Git, code reviews, CI/CD).
* Proven experience implementing LLM applications and/or AI agents in production, including evaluation and monitoring.
* Strong cloud\-native foundation (Azure/AWS/GCP) containers, orchestration, automated testing, release discipline, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated capability to establish reusable frameworks/SDKs, integration patterns, and scalable operating models for AI delivery.
* Excellent stakeholder communication ability to explain trade\-offs, risks, and outcomes clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences


****Required Skills****
 Business Intelligence (BI), Coding Best Practices, Computer Science, Cost Controls, Database Design, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Privacy, Data Science, Data Visualization, Digital Healthcare, End to End Management, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Infrastructure Automation, Machine Learning (ML), Operational Excellence, Reference Architectures, Responsible AI, Software Development, Stakeholder Communications, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Waterfall Model

title: Product Management Specialist
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and strategic intellectual to join our Product Management team as a Product Management Analyst/Specialist. This is a non\-supervisory position to provide support for USP’s new initiative Materials Program. The individual will be responsible for product pipeline through identification and evaluation of relevant potential materials to introduce into the catalogue, managing the product pre\-pipeline, gathering and prioritizing product and customer requirements, and working with internal teams to assess new material categories. Our ideal candidate should have a background in science and product management experience and be able to manage data analysis while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Product Management Analyst/Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**
* \[70%] Identification \& Evaluation
* Coordinate with Science and commercial teams to plan and identify new potential products for inclusion in the portfolio and maximize product launches. This will include utilizing chemistry knowledge, customer insights (market research studies, scientific knowledge/input, collection, and review of pharmacopeial information, market information, peer reviewed publications, and patents, ANDA submissions, etc.) to determine and segment potential impurities by main manufacturing pathways.
* Finalize technical attributes (CAS\#, Molecular Formula, Molecular Weight, IUPAC names etc) and Product attributes (rationale behind the potential targets) for new products.


 Additional objectives are to develop broad expertise in other areas to support new product introductions that will include API reference materials\& associated impurities, excipients, extractables and leachable, and more for potential inclusion into the materials portfolio.
   

  

* \[20 %] Market Assessment
* Understand industry/market trends and challenges, different customer segments, competitive analysis, and channel strategies as input to product launch roadmaps
* Evaluate product white space and portfolio gaps to identify additional product opportunities
* Assess product testing, needs pharmaceutical market especially generic drug market to identify new product development opportunities.
* Analyze trends in pharmaceutical standards catalog market including new product offerings, prices and discounts.
* Quantify market opportunities, primary and secondary research, generate data and establish product unit forecast
* \[10 %] Product Life Cycle Management
* Monitor product usage trends, sales performance, and customer feedback and demand to inform lifecycle decisions (product addition/deletion/promotion)
* Prepare periodic reports and dashboards on product performance.
* Identify/Evaluate product launch benchmarks including customer, market and financial performance indicators


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master’s degree in chemistry, Pharmacy, or a related field with a minimum of 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience as a process chemist with exposure to many API s \& diverse types of finished pharmaceutical products.
* Minimum 2\-3 years’ experience in product/portfolio management building new product portfolio
* Experience in developing projects/products in life science industry, CRO/CDMO or equivalent relevant experience.
* A thorough understanding of the development, production and testing of pharmaceutical materials, including APIs, excipients, and finished dosage forms.
* Proven experience in product development and management/portfolio management within the pharmaceutical/life science industry.
* Experience in handling software like Chemdraw, Chemfinder, Scifnder, Reaxys, Patent databases and other google search engines etc.
* Knowledge of standards used for pharmaceutical product testing such as analytical reference material, certified reference material, and reference standards.
* Experience with handling large amounts of data and information using scientific databases.
* Experience in reviewing pharmaceutical patents and patent claims.
* Experience in creating and maintaining dashboards (Excel (working with functions, pivot tables, data visualization), Tableau, or other platforms).
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and compliance.
* Good communication, interpersonal skills, and use of excel and Microsoft Office suite.
* Able to work flexible hours when needed in collaboration with global teams.
* Workload management skills; able to juggle a diverse and rapidly changing workload, delivering across several teams within a matrixed structure.
* Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data\-driven solutions.
* Self\-starter and highly self\-motivated, assumes personal accountability for results and performance.
* Strong written and verbal communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Knowledge of Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), patent landscape, freedom to operate analysis \& portfolio management
* Product Management Certification/MBA/ advanced degree preferred.
* Experienced at managing and analyzing business and product sales data/similar database tools.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 None, this is an individual contributor role.
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Ext. Affairs, Regulatory, \& Communications
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

title: Senior Technical Product Owner
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Technical Product Owner** 
 to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. This role will own products end\-to\-end, ensuring they deliver measurable business value, drive adoption, and support WSA's digital transformation journey.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* FinOps. Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
* Discovery for what comes next. New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
* Possibly more. Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
* Outcomes, not output. You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.


 What you will do
   

  

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
* Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
* Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
* Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
* Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
* Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
* Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area


**What You Bring**
* A technical background: 5\+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
* You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
* You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands\-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.
* You have made a case to senior stakeholders, won some and lost some, and can explain what you would do differently.
* You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
* You are interested in LLM\- and agent\-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi\-region team across time zones..


**Who We Are**
 At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
   

  

 Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
   

  

 With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
   

  

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**
 WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

title: Development Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 We are seeking a seasoned Associate Director – Technology Lead to provide hands‑on engineering leadership and delivery oversight across Appian (Low‑Code BPM), Talend (Data Integration), and SQL‑based data platforms. This role is critical to improving release predictability, production stability, and engineering quality across globally distributed teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep technical foundations with exceptional leadership, delivery discipline, and stakeholder management. This role is accountable not only for what we build, but how reliably and sustainably we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone who can set standards, enforce rigor, coach teams, and partner with business and technology stakeholders to ensure scalable, resilient, and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Technology \& Engineering Leadership
   

  

* Provide clear technical vision and strategic direction across Appian, Talend, and SQL\-based platforms.
* Establish and enforce solution architecture standards, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Serve as the senior technical authority, reviewing designs and challenging solutions that introduce delivery, scalability, or operational risk.
* Drive consistent adoption of enterprise engineering principles, including modularity, reusability, performance, and security\-by\-design.


 Delivery Excellence \& Operational Rigor
   

  

* Own end‑to‑end delivery accountability, from solution design through development, testing, release, and production stabilization.
* Address historical delivery issues by strengthening release readiness, defect prevention, and root\-cause remediation practices.
* Implement and govern SDLC controls, including design reviews, code quality standards, testing expectations, and production readiness criteria.
* Actively manage delivery risk, dependencies, and cross\-team coordination, particularly across globally distributed teams.
* Ensure predictable delivery through strong planning discipline, execution tracking, and escalation management.


 Quality, Stability \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Drive a quality\-first culture, prioritizing defect prevention over detection.
* Partner with QA and DevOps teams to improve test automation, CI/CD maturity, deployment reliability, and rollback strategies.
* Analyze production issues and missed delivery commitments to identify systemic gaps and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Define and track engineering metrics (e.g., defect leakage, release stability, cycle time) to continuously improve delivery performance.


 Platform \& Domain Leadership
   

  

* Lead and mentor multi\-disciplinary, global engineering teams, including: \- Appian BPM developers
* Talend data integration engineers
* SQL / data engineers
* Provide technical leadership for: \- Appian\-based workflow, BPM, and low‑code solutions
* Talend ETL / ELT pipelines and data integration architecture
* SQL data modeling, performance tuning, and optimization for enterprise workloads
* Ensure platform solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise data and integration standards.


 People Leadership \& Talent Development
   

  

* Build and lead high\-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Set clear expectations for accountability, ownership, and engineering excellence.
* Identify skill gaps and drive targeted upskilling across architecture, quality, and modern delivery practices.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning across geographies and functions.


 Stakeholder \& Enterprise Engagement
   

  

* Act as a trusted technology partner to product owners, business leaders, architects, and platform teams.
* Translate business objectives into practical, scalable technology solutions with clear delivery commitments.
* Provide concise, executive\-ready communication on delivery status, risks, and mitigation strategies.


**Qualifications**
* 12–15 years of technology experience, with 5\+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing enterprise delivery.
* Proven success leading cross\-functional, globally distributed engineering teams.
* Experience in large enterprise or financial services environments, with an appreciation for regulatory, risk, and operational controls


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Strong, hands\-on experience with Appian BPM architecture and low\-code development (L2 or L3 certification strongly preferred).
* Appian L2 or L3 certification preferred.
* Advanced expertise in SQL databases, including data modeling, performance tuning, data lineage, and governance considerations.
* Proven experience producing HLDs and LLDs, and leading complex system and data integrations.
* Solid understanding of APIs, microservices, and SaaS\-based integrations.
* Demonstrated experience with Talend or equivalent ETL/data integration platforms.
* Practical experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation across enterprise platforms.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Deputy Director -Service Modernization Lead
description:
**Overview**
 We are seeking a Deputy Director – Service Modernization \& AI\-led Engineering to lead the global service management product and engineering transformation of PepsiCo’s IT ecosystem, driving an AI\-first, data\-driven, engineering\-led, and experience\-focused operating model across a large, multi\-disciplinary organization.
   

  

 This role owns the IT Service Management product and operating model — spanning Process, Service Experience, Automation, AI\-led Engineering, Reliability, and Continuous Improvement — and leads service modernization initiatives that simplify ways of working, enable product\-led capabilities, automate operations, and embed intelligent, self\-healing patterns into the enterprise IT ecosystem.
   

  

 You will manage managers, senior engineering leads, and strategic vendors across a global organization, drive modernization and engineering portfolios, and represent Service Management product capability to PepsiCo leadership
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* 
* Own and evolve the IT Service Management product and operating model, integrating Process Management, Service Experience, Automation, AI\-led Engineering, Reliability Engineering, and Continuous Improvement frameworks across global operations.
* 
* Lead globally distributed teams, managing managers, senior engineering leads, product capability teams, automation teams, and vendors across service management, AI\-led engineering, and enterprise service modernization.
* 
* Drive teams in an agile, product\-oriented, and outcome\-focused way of working, ensuring clear priorities, measurable business outcomes, disciplined execution, and continuous delivery of value.
* 
* Establish and govern CSL/SLA KPI structures — performance dashboards, benchmarking, SLA/XLA tracking, engineering productivity metrics, service reliability metrics, and KPI Tree frameworks that connect operational performance to business value drivers.
* 
* Drive service modernization by partnering with platform and technology teams to harmonize fragmented service management capabilities, improve integration maturity, simplify workflows, and enable scalable, API\-first and event\-driven service experiences.
* 
* Build and scale ITSM product capabilities, workflow automation, service orchestration, and integration\-led services as part of an AI\-first operating model, including AIOps, conversational AI, chat/voice automation, Agentic AI, and intelligent workflow engineering to drive ticket deflection, ticket elimination, faster resolution, and productivity gains.
* 
* Lead engineering\-led service reliability improvements by embedding automation, observability, telemetry, root cause intelligence, proactive detection, and self\-healing patterns into the service management ecosystem.
* 
* Drive product and engineering practices across ITSM capabilities, including reusable integrations, automation frameworks, workflow standards, agile backlog management, release governance, prioritization, sprint planning, and scalable capability delivery.
* 
* Lead multi\-vendor governance, including Orchestrator–Operator models, across global functions, ensuring engineering accountability, delivery quality, cost\-efficiency, standardization, and centralization opportunities.
* 
* Drive cost\-of\-service optimization through automation, digitalization, product simplification, productivity engineering, and operating model simplification.
* Champion organizational change management, engineering capability building, AI adoption, agile maturity, and a performance\-oriented, customer\-led culture across global teams.


**Qualifications**
* 16\+ years of progressive IT/technology leadership experience, including direct experience leading large team, globally distributed organizations and managing managers/senior leads.
* Proven track record of enterprise ITSM/Service Management transformation in regulated, large\-scale environments (FMGC or comparable enterprise settings).
* Deep expertise in ServiceNow strategy, ITIL processes, and multi\-tool platform harmonization/consolidation.
* Demonstrated success building AIOps, ServiceNow integration and automation of services, and conversational AI/chatbot capabilities that measurably reduce MTTR, ticket volume, and manual effort.
* Strong governance experience: KPI/SLA/XLA frameworks, vendor governance, service catalogue management, and audit/compliance readiness.
* Experience owning multi\-million\-dollar budgets and driving cost\-of\-service optimization at enterprise scale.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership, Global Process Owners, and multi\-vendor ecosystems.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field; advanced management education (MBA) preferred.

title: Chief of Staff

 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
   

  

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
   

  

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

* Over $300 million raised in funding

 As the Chief of Staff, you will act as a strategic partner and right hand to the Regional CEO for Tide India and the SVP of Member Operations UK/Europe. You will collaborate closely with top management to understand business objectives, identify opportunities, and develop strategic plans. You will be instrumental in driving key initiatives, optimising operational efficiency, and ensuring the smooth execution of strategic priorities across the Tide Member Operations function.

* Conduct deep\-dive analysis and root cause investigations to uncover systemic inefficiencies.
* Partner with Ops, Product, and Training teams to implement sustainable fixes, acting as a central point of contact for cross\-functional initiatives to ensure alignment.

**Operational Excellence \& Planning**

* Act as a central point of contact for cross\-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment and clear communication between teams.
* Identify and drive process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.

* Act as a trusted advisor and liaison between the Regional CEO / SVP of MOPS UK\&EU and team leaders, ensuring alignment and resolving conflicts.


**What We Are Looking For**
**You are a strategic and analytical thinker:**
* Experience with a demonstrable track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional projects or programmes in technology organisations
* Proven track record of supporting senior leaders in a fast\-paced environment.
* You possess strong analytical skills and can translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
* You are comfortable working with ambiguity and can quickly adapt to new priorities.


**You Are An Exceptional Communicator And Collaborator**
* You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships with both the most junior and most senior people.
* You are highly organised and can manage multiple projects simultaneously.


**You Are Operationally Minded**
* You understand the intricacies of a large\-scale operations function.
* You are proactive and resourceful, with a strong ability to problem\-solve independently.


**What You’ll Get In Return**

With our new Hybrid working model \& Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you’ll get:
